sa: समुद्विग्ना विससृपुस्तथान्या भूतजातयः। तं दावं समुदैक्षन्त कृष्णौ चाभ्युद्यतायुधौ॥ उत्पातनादशब्देन त्रासिता इव च स्थिताः। ते वनं प्रसमीक्ष्याथ दह्यमानमनेकधा॥
en: They saw the fire and also two Krishnas ready with their weapons. Frightened at the fearful sounds, they lost their power of locomotion. Seeing the fire burning in innumerable places and seeing also Krishna with weapons to shoot them down they all set up a terrible roar.

sa: तार्क्ष्य उवाच किं नु श्रेयः पुरुषस्येह भद्रे कथं कुर्वन् न च्यवते स्वधर्मात्। आचक्ष्व मे चारुसर्वाङ्गि कुर्यां त्वया शिष्टो न च्यवेयं स्वधर्मात्॥
en: Tarkshya said: O blessed lady, what is the best thing for a man to do here on earth) and how he must act so that he may not deviate from (the path of) virtue. O beautiful lady, tell me all, so that being instructed by you I may not deviate from the path of my own duty (Dharma).

sa: यद्यागच्छति मां शक्रो ब्राह्मणच्छद्यना वृतः। हितार्थं पाण्डुपुत्राणां खेचरोत्तम भिक्षितुम्॥ दास्यामि विबुधश्रेष्ठ कुण्डले वर्म चोत्तमम्। न मे कीर्तिः प्रणश्येत त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता।॥
en: If, O best of sky-rangers, Shakra disguised as a Brahmana comes to me to beg (the earrings) for the good of the sons of Pandu, then, O best of the celestials, I will give the car-rings and the excellent armour. In that case my renown which has spread over the three worlds, will not be at a discount.

sa: अनग्निरनिकेतश्चाप्यगोत्रचरणो मुनिः। कौपीनाच्छादनं यावत् तावदिच्छेच चीवरम्॥ यावत् प्राणाभिसंधानं तावदिच्छेच भोजनम्। तथास्य वसतो ग्रामेऽरण्यं भवति पृष्ठतः॥ यस्तु कामान् परित्यज्य त्यक्तकर्मा जितेन्द्रियः। आतिष्ठेच मुनिर्मीनं स लोके सिद्धिमाप्नुयात्॥
en: A true Muni, withdrawn from all earthly objects, might live in a village, leading the life of a hermit. Chad in Kaupina (scantiest of robes,) he considers himself attired in the richest robe. He is content with food just sufficient to support life. He who abandons all desires, who has all his passions under complete control and who has given up all actions, is the man who attains success.

sa: सायं प्रातश्च संध्यां यो ब्राह्मणोऽभ्युपसेवते। प्रजपन् पावनी देवीं गायत्री वेदमातरम्॥ स तया पावितो देव्या ब्राह्मणो नष्टकिल्बिषः। न सीदेत् प्रतिगृहणनो महीमपि ससागराम्॥
en: That Brahmana who adores (the goddess) Sandhya in the morning and in the evening and who recites the sacred Gayatri, who is the mother of the Vedas, is cleansed from all his sins after being sanctified by the latter. Even if he accepts in gift the entire earth with her oceans, he does not suffer the least unhappiness.

sa: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः। हयं लक्षणसंपन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह॥ ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वे च विनियुज्य च। ततोऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिषम्॥ यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम्। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति च सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Having speedily despatched before all articles of sacrifice, Bharata's elder brother Rāma set free a black horse, gifted with all marks and worthy of the sacrifice and placed Lakşmaņa with Rtvik in charge of it. There upon the mighty-armed Kakuthstha, in the company of his soldiers, proceeded to the Naimiņa forest and beholding the wonderful sacrificial ground attained to an excess of delight and said:-It has become highly charming.

sa: ऋषयः ऊचुः अस्ति वै तव धर्मात्मान् विद्मो देवोपमं शुभम्॥ अपत्यमनघं राजन् वयं दिव्येन चक्षुषा। देवोद्दिष्टं नरव्याघ्र कर्मणेहोपपादय॥
en: The Rishis said : O virtuous minded man, O king, there is progeny for you that will be sinless, greatly fortunate and like the celestial themselves. We see this with our prophetic eyes. O best of kings, therefore, accomplish the purposes of the celestials by your acts.

sa: एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुर्मुनिपुङ्गवम्। एवं भवतु भद्रं ते तिष्ठन्त्वेतानि सर्वशः॥ गगने तान्यनेकानि वैश्वानरपथाद् बहिः। नक्षत्राणि मुनिश्रेष्ठ तेषु ज्योतिःषु जाज्वलन्॥ अवाक्शिरास्त्रिंशङ्कुश्च श्च तिष्ठत्वमरसंनिभः। अनुयास्यन्ति चैतानि ज्योतींषि नृपसत्तमम्॥ कृतार्थं कीर्तिमन्तं च स्वर्गलोकगतं यथा। विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतः॥
en: Thus addressed, the deities answered that best of ascetics saying, 'So be it, good betide you! All these innumerable stars, O foremost of anchorets, shall remain in the firmament outside the path of Vaiśvānara (Zodiac); and shining in their splendour, Trisanku shall dwell with bended head, like to an immortal. And all these luminous bodies shall follow that best of kings, illustrious and successful, as if he had attained heaven itself.' And the virtuous and exceedingly energetic Viśvāmitra, thus assured by the celestials, said in the midst of the saints, 'You gods, excellent well.'

sa: देवि नूनं न जानीषे महद् भयमुपस्थितम्। इदं तव च दुःखाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च॥ गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यं किमनेनासनेन मे। विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयं मामुपस्थितः॥
en: O worshipful one, certain it is that you know not the great impending calamity; It is for the distress of yours, Laksmana and Vaidehi, that shall I wend my way to the Daņdaka forest. What is the use of a seat to me then? Now is the time come when I deserve a seat made of Kusa grass.

sa: इति दुःखाभिसंतप्तं विलपन्तमचेतनम्। घूर्णमानं महाराजं शोकेन समभिप्लुतम्॥ पारं शोकार्णवस्याशु प्रलपन्तं पुनः पुनः। प्रत्युवाचाथ कैकेयी रौद्रा रौद्रतरं वचः॥
en: When the terrible Kaikeyī in still more terrible language addressed the mighty king, who was burning in grief, and bewailing, and deprived of his senses, and feeling a sensation of whirling, and overwhelmed with woe, and again and again beseeching for crossing this ocean of sorrow, saying.

sa: ततः शैलवरे रम्ये बभूवाभिरतो मुनिः॥ भार्गवश्च्यवनो नाम हिमवन्तमुपाश्रितः। तत्र चैका महाभागा भार्गवं देववर्चसम्॥ ववन्दे पद्मपत्राक्षी काङ्क्षन्ती सुतमुत्तमम्। तमृषि साभ्युपागम्य कालिन्दी चाभ्यवादयत्॥
en: And it came to pass that at this time, Bhrgu's son, the ascetic Cyavana, had become addicted to the romantic Himavat, foremost of mountains. And here one of those exalted dames with eyes resembling lotus-petals, saluting Bhrigu's son born shining like a celestial, desired of him an excellent. son. And drawing near to that sage, Kalindi saluted him.

sa: ह्रदश्च कुशवानेष यत्र पद्मं कुशेशयम्। आश्रमश्चैव रुक्मिण्या यत्राशाम्यदकोपना॥ समाधीनां समासस्तु पाण्डवेय श्रुतस्त्वया। तं द्रक्ष्यसि महाराज भृगुतुझं महागिरिम्॥
en: Yonder is the lake called Kushavanisha in which grow the lotuses called Kushashaya. Here also is the hermitage of Rukmini where she attained peace by conquering her anger. O son of Pandu, O great king, you must have heard of the great hill Bhrigutunga. Behold it (now).

sa: गत्वा वीरप्रमोक्षं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। कृत्तिकामघयोश्चैव तीर्थमासाद्य भारत॥ अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलमाप्नोति मानवः। तत्र संध्यां समासाद्य विद्यातीर्थमनुत्तमम्॥ उपस्पृश्य च वै विद्यां यत्र तत्रोपपद्यते। महाश्रमे वसेद् रात्रिं सर्वपापप्रमोचने॥ एककालं निराहारो लोकानावसते शुभान्।
en: Going to Virapramoksha one is cleansed of all his sins. O descendant of Bharata, going then to the Tirtha, called Kirtika and Magha, a man obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma and Atiratha (sacrifices). Then going to the excellent Tirtha called Vidya in the evening. He who bathes there obtain every kind of knowledge. Then one should live one night at Mahasrama, which is capable of destroying all sins. By taking a single meal there a man obtains many blessed regions.

sa: त्रिखर्वं बलिमादाय द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः। ब्राह्मणा वाटधानाच गोमन्तः शतसङ्घशः॥ कमण्डलूनुपादाय जातरूपमयाञ्छुभान्। एवं बलिं समादाय प्रवेशं लेभिरे न च॥ शतं दासीसहस्राणां कासिकनिवासिनाम्॥
en: At the gate with hundred millions of tribute and were denied admittance. Hundreds of Brahmanas, possessing wealth of kine and living upon the lands that Yudhishthira gave them, came there with their handsome golden Kamandalus (water-pot) filled with Ghee. Though they brought such tribute, yet they were refused admittance. Hundred thousands of serving maids of the Karpasika country.

sa: मित्रतामनुवृत्तं तु समुपेक्षेत पण्डितः। प्रदीप्य यः प्रदीप्ताग्नि प्राक् चिरं नाभिधावति। भस्मापि न स विन्देत शिष्टं क्वचन भारत॥
en: When advice is offered in a friendly spirit, the learned man does not (very much) mind it. O descendant of Bharata, he who sets fire to such a highly inflammable object as camphor, can not see its ashes, if he does not hasten to extinguish the fire.

sa: अवासीदच्च कौन्तेय दत्तमात्रा मही तदा। उवाच चापि कुपिता लोकेश्वरमिदं प्रभुम्॥ न मां माय भगवन् कस्मैचिद् दातुमर्हसि। प्रदानं मोघमेतत् ते यास्याम्येषा रसातलम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, as soon as earth was given away, she became sad; and thus she spoke in anger to the exalted lord of the world, “O exalted one, you should not have given me away to any mortal. Your this giving me away would come to nothing, for I am going down to the nether world."

sa: दैत्या हिंसानुरक्ताश्च अवध्याः सुरसत्तमैः। राक्षसाश्चापि लोकेऽस्मिन् यदोत्पत्स्यन्ति दारुणाः॥ तदाहं सम्प्रसूयामि गृहेषु शुभकर्मणाम्। प्रविष्टो मानुषं देहं सर्वं प्रशमयाम्यहम्॥
en: When fearful and vicious-minded Daityas and Rakshasas, that are incapable of being killed by even the foremost of the celestials, are born on earth, I then take my birth in the families of virtuous men. And assuming a human form, 1 restore peace by destroying all evils.

sa: हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य यानयुग्यस्य वाससाम्। आविष्टः कलिना द्यूते जीयते स्म नलस्तदा॥ तमक्षमदसम्मत्तं सुहृदां न तु कश्चन। निवारणेऽभवच्छतो दीव्यमानमरिदमम्॥
en: Being taken up by Kali, the prince Nala lost at dice his gold and silver statues, his cars with their teams and also the valuable garments. The illustrious chastiser of the foes was maddened at the game, from which none of his friends could make him desist.

sa: यदि स्वस्ति प्रजायन्ते जाता जीवन्ति वा यदि। सम्भाविता जातबलास्ते दधुर्यदि नः सुखम्॥ इह चामुत्र चैवेति कृपणाः फलहेतवः।
en: Passing their days in misery and in expectation of fruit, they always ask themselves-Shall these come out of the womb safely? Shall these live after birth? Shall they grow in power and be honoured on Earth? Will they give us happiness in this and the next world?

sa: अथ चेदाभिवर्तेत राज्यार्थी बलवत्तरः। अराजकाणि राष्ट्राणि हतवीर्याणि वा पुनः॥ प्रत्युद्गम्याभिपूज्यः स्यादेतदत्र सुमन्त्रितम्। न हि पापात् परतरमस्ति किञ्चिदराजकात्॥
en: If a powerful king approaches kingdoms weakened by anarchy, with a view to annex them to his dominions, the people should go forward and receive the invader with honour. Such conduct would be quite of a piece with wise counsels. There is no evil greater than anarchy.

sa: तत्र भीमो महाबाहुर्वायुवेगपराक्रमः। आर्यामाश्वासयामास भ्रातूंश्चापि वृकोदरः॥ वैनतेयो यथा पक्षी गरुत्मान् पततां वरः। तथैवाभिपतिष्यामि भयं वो नेह विद्यते॥
en: Draupadi said : Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima Vrikodara whose prowess is like that of wind, comforted the revered madam (Kunti) and his brothers. I will spring up into the air like the son of Vinata that best of birds, Garuda. We have no fear from this fire.

sa: मेनिरे परितोषेण नृपाः स्वर्गसदो यथा। नात्र शोको भयं त्रासो नारति यशोऽभवत्।।९। परस्परं समागम्य योधानां भरतर्षभ। समागतास्ताः पितृभिर्भ्रातृभिः पतिभिः सुतैः॥ मुदं परमिकां प्राप्य नार्यो दुःखमथात्यजन्। एकां रात्रि विहृत्यैव ते वीरास्ताश्च योषितः॥ आमन्त्र्यान्योन्यमाश्लिष्य ततो जग्मुर्यथागतम्। ततो विसर्जयामास लोकांस्तान् मुनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Indeed, the Kshatriya warriors, on account of the happiness they experienced, considered that place as Heaven itself. There was no grief, no fear, ne suspicion, no discontent, no reproach in that region, as those warriors, O king, met with one another on that night, Meeting with their sires and brothers and husbands and sars. the Indias ........ grief and felt great joy. Having sported with one another thus for one night, those heroes and those ladies, embracing one another taking one another's leave, came back to the places they had come from. Indeed, that foremost of ascetics dismissed that collection of warriors.

sa: स यस्य पुण्डरीकाक्षः प्रीतियुक्तो भविष्यति। तस्य देवगणः प्रीतो ब्रह्मपूर्वो भविष्यति॥ यश्च तं मानवे लोके संश्रयिष्यति केशवम्। तस्य कीर्तिर्जयश्चैव स्वर्गश्चैव भविष्यति॥ धर्माणांदेशिकः साक्षात् स भविष्यति धर्मभा।
en: I do not find any difference in this. Know this, O Rishis having asceticism for wealth. That person with whom the lotus-eyed Vasudeva becomes pleased, is liked by all the deities with Brahman amongst them. That man who will seek the protection of Keshava will succeed in acquiring great achievements and victory and Heaven. He will be an instructor in religion and duties, and will acquire great religious merit.

sa: वर्षिष्यतीह वा देवो न वा वर्षं भविष्यति। अथावाभ्यर्थनामिन्द्रो न करिष्यति कामतः॥ स्वयमिन्द्रो भविष्यामि जीवयिष्यामि च प्रजाः। यो यदाहारजातश्च स तथैव भविष्यति॥
en: It matters little whether the deity pours rain or no downpours come. Indeed, if Indra does not, of his own will, show any regard for me, I shall, in that case, change myself into Indra and keep all creatures alive. Every creature, on whatever food he has been nourished, will continue to be nourished on it as before.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तु राजेन्द्र कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्। भीमसेनादवरजः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥ जिष्णुः सहिष्णुर्धष्णुश्च स एनं पालयिष्यति। शक्तः स हि महीं जेतुं निवातकवचान्तकः॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : Thus addressed (by king Yudhishthira), O king, the Island-born Krishna said, He who is born after Bhimasena, who is the foremost of all bowmen, who is called Jishnu, who is gifted with great patience and capable of overcoming all resistance, he will protect the horse. That destroyer of the Nivatakavachas can conquer the whole Earth.

sa: यत् स्यादिष्ट्वा राजसूये फलं तु यत् स्यादिष्ट्वा बहुना काञ्चनेन। एतत् तुल्यं फलमप्याहुरग्र्यं सर्वे सन्तस्त्वृषयो ये च सिद्धाः॥
en: The merit which one wins by celebrating the Rajasuya sacrifice, the merit that one acquires by making gifts of heaps of gold, that high merit is acquired by a person who shows such respect for kine. Virtuous Rishis and great persons crowned with success have said so.

sa: बाणवेगं हि कस्तस्य शक्तः सोढुं महात्मनः। प्रव्रज्यायां हि मे हेतुः स एव पुरुषर्षभः॥ विनाशमुखमेतत् वे केनाख्यातं दुरात्मना।
en: Is there any body who can stand the fury of the arrows of that high-souled one? That most heroic mortal is the cause of my leading this ascetic life. What wicked-minded creature has given you this advice which will lead you to the very mouth of destruction?”

sa: तत्रानिमित्ततो दैवात् सूतं कश्मलमाविशत्। तदाऽऽचचक्षे विदुरः सभायां राजसंसदि॥ संजयोऽयं महाराज मूर्च्छितः पतितो भुवि। वाचं न सृजते कांचिद्धीनप्रज्ञोऽल्पचेतनः॥
en: Without any reason, as if by the hand of the gods, the Suta suddenly fell down. Then in that assembly of kings, in that council chamber, Vidura said loudly-This Sanjaya, O great king, has fallen down senseless; and he cannot utter one word bereft of his wisdom.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा प्राद्रवत् काञ्चनमाल्यधारिणी ज्येष्ठेन भ्रात्रा प्रहिता यशस्विनी। सुदक्षिणा वेदिविलग्नमध्या सा पद्मपत्राभनिभा शिखण्डिनी॥ तन्वी शुभाङ्गी मणिचित्रमेखला मत्स्यस्य राज्ञो दुहिता श्रिया वृता। तन्नर्तनागारमरालपक्षमा शतह्रदा मेघमिवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dispatched by her elder brother, the illustrious daughter of the king of Matsya's, wearing a golden necklace, ever obedient, having a waist slender like that of a wasp, beautiful like Lakshmi, adorned with the plumes of a peacock, of a slender make, beautiful limbs, wearing a zone of pearls, graceful, having slightly curved eye-lashes, speedily went to the dancing-hall like a flash of lightning towards of clouds.

sa: तस्य पाणिं ग्रहीष्यामो जवेनाभिप्रयास्यतः॥ न ह्येनमतिसंक्रुद्धमेको युध्येत संयुगे।
en: We shall attach his sides who is advancing quickly. None can alone fight with him in battle when worked up with anger

sa: अद्याहमृणमक्षय्यं पुरा वाचा प्रतिश्रुतम्। धार्तराष्ट्राय दास्यामि निहत्य समरेऽर्जुनम्॥
en: Killing Arjuna in battle I shall satisfy, to day, the debt which it is hard to repay, I made formerly to Duryodhana.

sa: इतश्चेतश्च निर्मुक्तैः काञ्चनैर्गार्धवाजितैः। दृश्यतामद्य वै व्योम खद्योतैरिव संवृतम्॥
en: Golden arrows having the wings of vultures being discharged on all sides let the sky today appear as filled with fire flies.

sa: अनाहतश्च निष्क्रान्तो महद् वेदयते भयम्॥ भवतां रोमकूपाणि प्रहृष्टान्युपलक्षये।
en: An they go out openly. It presages a great calamity. The hairs of your bodies are seen to stand on their ends.

sa: ततस्ते जवना धुर्या जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्। उत्तरश्चापि संत्रस्तो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: At that sound the quick-coursing horses dropped down their knees on earth. Uttara too, stricken with fear, sat down on the car.

sa: दृष्ट्वा त्वां पाण्डवैवीरैर्धातृभिः सह संगतम्। यावदानन्दजाश्रूणि प्रमुञ्चन्तु नराधिपाः॥
en: Let all these rulers of men shed tears of joy at beholding yourself united in peace with your brothers who are heroes.

sa: राजश्रियाभिवृद्धश्च सुयोधनवशानुगः॥ पश्चादेष प्रयातव्यो न मे विजकरो भवेत्।
en: Always treated with regal prosperity he is a follower of Duryodhana. You should approach him last for he will never injure me.

sa: अहं पारे समुद्रस्य पृथिव्या वा परम्परात्। गत्वाऽऽत्मानं विमुञ्चामि किं फलं जीवितेन मे॥
en: Having gone to the other side of the sea or going to the most distant part of the world, I shall cast off my life. What is the use of my living on?

sa: अविजित्य य आत्मानममात्यान् विजिगीषते। अमित्रान् वाजितामात्यः सोऽवशः परिहीयते॥
en: He, who without conquering self, wants to conquer his ministers wants to conquer his enemies, is soon brought under subjection by others.

sa: कारणस्य तु दौर्बल्याच्चिन्तयामि महामुने। अस्य देहकरस्तात मम पुत्रो महाद्युते॥ भक्षितौ वैनतेयेन दुःखार्तास्तेन वै वयम्। पुनरेव च तेनोक्तं वैनतेयेन गच्छता। मासेनान्येन सुमुखं भक्षयिष्य इति प्रभो॥
en: But, O great Muni, we hesitate owing to the unstable character of the cause; the author of his being, my son of great luster, has been enter up by the son of Vinata and for that reason we are struck with grief; and when the son of Vinata was going away he again said-After a month I shall eat the other one of this race) Sumukha.

sa: ह्रियमाणं तु सुग्रीवं कुम्भकर्णेन रक्षसा॥ अवेक्ष्याभ्यद्रवद् वीरः सौमित्रर्मित्रनन्दनः।
en: Seeing Sugriva (thus) seized by the Rakshasa Kumbhakarna, the war-like son of Sumitra, the delighter of his friends, rushed (to his rescue).

sa: सुमुखस्य गुणैश्चैव शीलशौचदमादिभिः। अभिगम्य स्वं कन्यामयं दातुं समुद्यतः॥
en: Coming here attracted by the accomplishments, good manners, purity of life and self-control of Sumukha, he himself ready to offer his daughter.

sa: विस्फार्य सुमहच्चापं हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। भारद्वाजोऽथ संक्रुद्धः फाल्गुनं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Then inflated with anger, the son of Bharadvaja, drawing his huge bow plated with gold and hard to be severed, struck Phalguni.

sa: ऐरावणो नागराजो वामनः कुमुदोञ्जनः। प्रसूताः सुप्रतीकस्य वंशे वारणसत्तमाः॥
en: Here in the race of Supratika are born those best among elephants, namely Airavana, the king among elephants, Kumuda, Vamana and Arjuna.

sa: तथोडग्रसेनस्य सुतं सुदुष्टं वृष्ण्यन्धकानां मध्यगतं समास्थम्। अपातयद् बलदेवद्वितीयो हत्वा ददौ चोग्रसेनाय राज्यम्॥
en: Then did he, having Baladeva as his coadjutor, fell down the extremely wicked son of Baladeva who was seated in court amidst the Vrishnis and Andhakas and then bestowed the kingdom on Ugrasena.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तां कुन्तीमाविवेश विहङ्गमः। स्वर्भानुशत्रुर्योगात्मा नाभ्यां पस्पर्श चैव ताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said to her "be it so” that ranger of sky, the enemy of Svarbhanu, with his soul absorbed in yoga entered into Kunti and touched her on the naval.

sa: अमरेष्विव देवेन्द्रो मानुषेषु धनंजयः। एकः कोऽस्मानुपायायादन्यो लोके धनंजयात्॥
en: His movement is also like his; he cannot be but Dhananjaya. As Indra is amongst the immurtals so is Dhananjaya amongst men.

sa: ततो रथेन शुभ्रेण महता किङ्किणीकिना। हेमजालविचित्रेण लधुना मेघनादिना॥
en: With his white chariot and large, furnished with tinkling balls and ornamented with gold, with wheels clattering like the roaring of clouds,

sa: वालिपुत्रोऽङ्गदश्चैव ये चान्ये प्लवगर्षभाः। विचेतुं दक्षिणामाशां राजन् प्रस्थापितास्त्वया॥
en: Angada, the son of Bali and other foremost of monkeys who, O monarch, were despatched by you to search the southern direction."

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रवनं घोर नरसिंहाभिरक्षितम्। अहमुत्पाटयिष्यामि वैराटे व्येतु ते भयम्॥
en: I shall forsooth eradicate the dreadful Dhritarashtra forest although protected by many powerful heroes. Therefore remove your fear, O son of Virata."

sa: नित्यं स्वाहा नित्यं दद्युर्मानुषदेवताः। दीर्घमायुर्धनं पुत्रान् सम्यगाराधिताः शुभाः॥
en: Svadha, and Svaha as also the blessings of a life, wealth, sons are ever given by gods and men, when duly gratified.

sa: श्मशानमभितो गत्वा आससाद कुरूनथ। तां शमीमन्ववीक्षेतां व्यढानीकांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Those two repressors of enemies espied the army of the powerful Kurus. And going towards the cremation ground they reached the Kurus.

sa: तावब्रूतां वृणीष्वेति तदा भरतसत्तम। अथैतावब्रवीच्छक्रः साह्यं नः क्रियतामिति॥
en: Those two then said “Choose (the boon)," O best of the race of Bharata. Shakra then said to those two-"make us invincible".

sa: इत्युक्त्वा तामनिन्द्यागी स राक्षसमहेश्वरः। तत्रैवान्तर्हितो भूत्वा जगामाभिमतां दिशम्॥
en: Thus addressing that lady of faultless proportions, the lord of the Rakshasas vanished at that very spot and went whether he liked.

sa: उपपल्वन्ति चित्रस्ता रथेभ्यो रथिनस्तथा। सादिनचाश्वपृष्ठेभ्यो भूमौ चैव पदातयः॥
en: Possessed by fear, the car-warriors began to leap down from their cars, the horse-men from horse-back, and the infantry to fly away.

sa: स्वप्ना हि सुमहाघोरा दृष्टा मेऽनिष्टदर्शनाः। विनाशायास्य दुर्बुद्धेः पौलस्त्यकुलघातिनः॥
en: I have dreamed an awfully-terrible dream of evil omen, indicative of the destruction of this evil-minded destroyer of the race of Pulastya.

sa: धूमायन्ते व्यपेतानि ज्वलन्ति सहितानि च। धृतराष्ट्रोल्मकानीव ज्ञातयो भरतर्षभ॥
en: Separated pieces of burning wood produce only smoke; but united they blaze. The same is the case, O Dhritarashtra, with blood relations.

sa: ते ध्वजं पाण्डुपुत्रस्य समासाद्य पतत्रिणः। ज्वलन्तं कपिमाजघ्नुर्ध्वजाग्रनिलयांश्च तान्॥
en: Reaching the flag-staff of the son of Pandu, those winged arrows struck the blowing monkey and other creatures stationed on the flag-staff.

sa: उत्तर उवाच अद्याहमनुगच्छेयं दृढधन्वा गवां पदम्। यदि मे सारथिः कश्चिद् भवेदश्वेषु कोविदः॥
en: Uttara said An expert in the use of bow as I am, I shall today go out in pursuit of kine, if some body, skilled in the management of horses, becomes my charioteer.

sa: यादृशैः संनिविंशते यादृशांश्चोपसेवते। यादृगिच्छेच्च भवितुं तादृग् भवति पूरुषः॥
en: A man becomes like him with whom he associates or him whom he serves or him like whom he seeks to be.

sa: हंस उवाच एतत् कार्यममराः संश्रुतं मे धृतिः शमः सत्यधर्मानुवृत्तिः। ग्रन्धि विनीय हृदयस्य सर्वं प्रियाप्रिये चात्मसमं नयीत॥
en: The mendicant Rishi said O immortals, it has been heard by me that tranquility, self-control and the observance of true religion practiced until all the knots of one's heart be loosened bring for the agreeable and disagreeable to the level of one's own self.

sa: यथैषां मामकास्तात तथैषां पाण्डवा अपि। पौत्रा भीष्मस्य शिष्याश्च द्रोणस्य च कृपस्य च॥
en: As these are, O dear, to my sons, so are they to the Pandavas (in ties of blood and affection). They (the Pandavas) are grandsons of Bhishma and disciples of Drona and Kripa.

sa: तस्यैव च न पश्यामि युधि गाण्डीवधन्वनः। अनिशं चिन्तयानोऽपि यः प्रतीयाद् रथेन तम्॥
en: I do not see any one equal in battle to the one who has the Gandiva bow, who seated on a car could oppose him, though I think about it day and night.

sa: प्रशाम्य भरतश्रेष्ठ भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः। रक्षेमां पृथिवीं सर्वां मृत्योर्दष्ट्रान्तरं गताम्॥ ज्येष्ठो भ्राता धर्मशीलो वत्सलः श्लक्ष्णवाक् कविः।
en: O foremost among the Bharatas, make peace along with your brothers with the sons of Pandu. Save this entire earth which has come under the very jaws of death. Your elder brother is of virtuous habits of life, affectionate, sweet of speech and wise.

sa: विदुर उवाच तस्माद् राजेन्द्र भूम्यर्थं नानृतं वक्तुमर्हसि। मा गम: ससुतामात्यो नाशं पुत्रार्थमब्रुवन्॥
en: Vidura said Therefore, O chief among kings you should not speak an untruth for the sake of land. Do not ruin yourself with your sons and ministers by refraining from speaking the truth.

sa: वाहनान्यप्रहृष्टानि रुदन्तीव विशाम्पते। गृध्रास्ते पर्युपासन्ते सैन्यानि च समन्ततः॥
en: Our soldiers are cheerless and weeping as it were, O lord of the universe and vultures are constantly wheeling around our army.

sa: ध्रुवस्तस्य जयस्तात यथेन्द्रस्य जयस्तथा। कृष्णावेकरथे यत्तावधिज्यं गाण्डिवं धनुः॥
en: He has victory certain 0 dear, as the victory of Indra. The two Krishna's on one car and the stringed Gandiva bow.

sa: यश्च सेन्द्रानिमाल्लोकानिच्छन् कुर्याद् वशे बली। स स्रष्टा जगतः कृष्णः पाण्डवानां जये धृतः॥
en: Even that mighty one who by his mere wish could bring under control these worlds with Indra, that creator of the world, Krishna, has set his mind on the victory of the Pandavas.

sa: व्यमुञ्चच्छरवर्षाणि सतोय इव तोयदः॥ तं भीमो भीमकर्माणं सुशर्माणमथाद्रवत्।
en: And discharged from it a shower of shafts like a cloud surcharged with water. Bhima then fell upon Susharma of dreadful deeds.

sa: यक्ष उवाच कः शत्रुर्दुर्जयः पुंसां कश्च व्याधिरनन्तकः। कीदृशश्च स्मृतः साधुरसाधुः कीदृशः स्मृतः॥
en: The Yaksha asked What is the invincible enemy of men? What is (their) permanent disease? What sort of men is regarded as honest? And what kind of men is spoken of as dishonest?

sa: स्तत्र साह्यं दीयतां मे भवद्भिः। ते चाब्रुवन् नहुष घोररूपो दृष्टीविषस्तस्य विभीम ईश॥
en: "Nahusha, the king of the gods is of a terrible form; therefore assistance to me must be rendered by you.” They too said-"Nahusha is terrible-looking and we fear, O lord, his poisonous gaze.

sa: ततः प्रकाशमासाद्य पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत। घोररूपं ततस्ते स्म नावैक्षन्त परस्परम्॥
en: When every thing came in view, the battle began again; and it became so dreadful that they could not see each other.

sa: कुम्भकर्णो बलेनासीत् सर्वेभ्योऽभ्यधिको युधि। मायावी रणशौण्डश्च रौद्रश्च रजनीचरः॥
en: The Rakshasa Kumbhakarna was the most powerful in battle; he was fierce, terrible and a perfect master of the arts of illustration.

sa: पुष्पोत्कटायां जज्ञाते द्वौ पुत्रौ राक्षसेश्वरौ। कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ बलेनाप्रतिमौ भुवि॥
en: He begot on Pushpotkata two sons, the lords of the Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna and the tenheaded (Ravana) both unequalled in prowess on earth.

sa: एष धर्मे दमे चैव क्रोधे चापि जितव्रतः। महाप्रसादो ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवादी च पार्थिवः॥
en: This king has resolved to control the sensory organs, always prepared to execute all what is legitimate and has ail extreme control on anger. He is kind hearted, devotee to Brahmins and truthful.

sa: यदा द्रोणं च भीष्मं च पाञ्चाल्यौ पातयिष्यतः। तदा यज्ञावसानं तद् भविष्यति जनार्दन॥
en: When Drona and Bhishma will be overthrown by the two princes of Panchala, then will the ceremonies connected with the sacrifice of the son of Dhritarashtra be brought to an end, O Janardana.

sa: येषां युधिष्ठिरो नेता गोप्ता च मधुसूदनः। योधौ च पाण्डवौ वीरौ सव्यसाचिवृकोदरौ॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। सात्यकिर्दुपदश्चैव धृष्टकेतुश्च सानुजः॥ उत्तमौजाश्च पाञ्चाल्यो युधामन्युश्च दुर्जयः। शिखण्डी क्षत्रदेवश्च तथा वैराटिरुत्तरः॥ काशयश्चेदयश्चैव मत्स्याः सर्वे च सुंजयाः। विराटपुत्रो बभ्रुश्च पञ्चालाश्च प्रभद्रकाः॥ येषामिन्द्रोऽप्यकामानां न हरेत् पृथिवीमिमाम्। वीराणां रणधीराणां ये भिन्द्युः पर्वतानपि॥ तान् सर्वगुणसम्पन्नानमनुष्यप्रतापिनः। क्रोशतो मम दुष्पुत्रो योद्भुमिच्छति संजय॥
en: son Those whose leader is Yudhishthira and whose protector is the slayer of Madhu and whose warriors are the heroic sons of Pandu, Savyasachin and Vrikodara and Nakula, Sahadeva, Dhrishtadyumna, the of Prishata, Satyki, Drupada, with his brother and the king of the Panchalas, endued with excellent prowess and the invincible Yudhamanyu and Shikhandin and Kshatradeva and Uttra and the son Virata and the Kashis, the Chedis, the Matsyas and all the Srinjayas, the son of Virata, Babhru, the Panchalas and the Prabhadrakas. From these even Indra himself cannot wrest this Earth, if they are not so willing-the heroes, who are cool and composed in battle and who are capable even of breaking the mountains, my wicked son desires to fight, O Sanjaya-these endued with all the virtues and endued with sup

sa: एष ते वामनो नाम प्रादुर्भावः प्रकीर्तितः। तेन देवाः प्रादुरासन् वैष्णवं चोच्यते जगत्॥
en: This history which I have just related is known as the incarnation of the dwarf; from him all the celestials came into being and the universe is called Vaishnava (or pervaded by Vishnu).

sa: अरणीसहितं चेदं ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छत। जिज्ञासार्थं मया ह्येतदाहृतं मृगरूपिणा॥
en: Now give to that Brahmana these fire-sticks which I carried away in the shape of a deer in order to test you.

sa: पडिमानि विनश्यन्ति मुहूर्तमनवेक्षणात्। गाव: सेवा कृषिर्भार्या विद्या वृषलसंगतिः॥
en: The curious the malicious, the discontented, the wrathful, the ever suspicious and those living on other people's fortunesthese six are alwu miserable.

sa: एवमुक्तो धर्मराजः पार्थमैक्षद् धनंजयम्। ईक्षितश्चार्जुनो भ्रात्रा मत्स्यं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus addressed, the pious king Yudhishthira looked towards Dhananjaya. And looked at by his brother, Arjuna said to the king of Matsya's.

sa: अभ्राता विदितः पूर्वं युद्धकाले प्रकाशितः। पाण्डवान् यदि गच्छामि किं मां क्षत्रं वदिष्यति॥
en: Unknown as a brother before, and known to be so on the eve of battle, if I go over to the side of the sons of Pandu who will call me a Kshatriya.

sa: सेनामुखे प्रयुद्धानां भीमसेनो भविष्यति। तं सर्वे संश्रयिष्यन्ति प्राकारमकुतोभयम्॥
en: In front of the fighting soldiers Bhimasena will stand and all will be shatered behind him as behind a strong wall, fearlessly.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यथा विराटनगरे तव पूर्वपितामहाः। अज्ञातवासमुषितास्तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप॥
en: Vaishampayana said Listen, O ruler of men, how your great grand-fathers spent their days in the city of Virata without being discovered.

sa: भीमसेनार्जुनौ चापि श्रुत्वा क्रोशगतं रिपुम्। स्वयमश्वांस्तुदन्तौ तौ जवेनैवाभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Hearing that the enemy has gone only two miles Bhima and Arjuna spurred their horses to greatest speed in pursuit of him.

sa: मृदुर्वदान्यो ह्रीमांश्च धार्मिकः सत्यविक्रमः। राजंस्त्वमापदाऽऽकृष्टः किं करिष्यसि पाण्डव॥
en: O king, you are gentle, charitable, modest, righteous, and true to promise. O Pandava, what will you do, although afflicted with calamity.

sa: प्रहितो धृतराष्ट्रेण दूतः क्षत्तारमब्रवीत्। ईश्वरस्त्वां महाराजो महाप्राज्ञ दिदृक्षति॥
en: Being sent by Dhritarashtra the messenger said to the Kshatriya-"O you of great wisdom, my lord, the king wants to see you."

sa: सुरथस्तं गजवरं वधाय नकुलस्य तु। प्रेषयामास सक्रोधमत्युच्छ्रितकरं ततः॥
en: Thereupon desiring to kill Nakula at once Suratha goaded his huge and infuriated elephant with its trunk upraised (to rush towards him).

sa: इन्द्रसेनद्वितीयस्तु रथात् प्रस्कन्ध धर्मराट्। हताश्वः सहदेवस्य प्रतिपेदे महारथम्॥
en: Having his horse thus slain the pious king, with Indrasena, descended from his chariot and got upon the huge car of Sahadeva.

sa: कुमारश्च कलिङ्गानामीश्वरो युद्धदुर्मदः। एतेषां प्रेष्यतां शीघ्रमेतद्धि मम रोचते।॥
en: And Kumara and the Prince of the Kalingas haughty in battle. I think that you should send (messengers) quickly warinvitation to him.

sa: प्रियमेतदुपश्रुत्य शत्रूणां च पराभवम्। कृतकृत्यश्च कौरव्य विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्॥
en: Hearing this pleasant news of the defeat of our enemy, do you decide, O Kauravya, as to what you should do hereafter.

sa: शूरोऽस्मीति न दृप्तः स्याद् बुद्धिमानिति वा पुनः। प्रियमेवाचरन् राज्ञः प्रियो भवति भोगवान्॥
en: A person that does not take pride in thinking "I am heroic and intelligent," and conducts himself agreeably to the wishes of the king is worthy of royal favour and amenities of life.

sa: तं विस्मयन्ती शनकैः संज्ञाभिरिदमब्रवीत्। गन्धर्वराजाय नमो येनास्मि परिमोचिता॥
en: She wonderingly said to him in words intelligible to them: “Salutation to that king of Gandharvas by whom I have been released.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अवाग् गान्धारि पुत्रस्ते गच्छत्येष सुदुर्मतिः। ईधुंदुरात्मा मानी च श्रेयसां वचनातिगः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Gandhari, this wicked-minded son of yours would precipitate himself in misery. This evil-souled one, of an envious disposition and vain, he would not listen to the advice of his elders.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच वधार्थं यः समुत्पन्नः शिखण्डी दुपदात्मजः। वदन्ति सिद्धा राजेन्द्र ऋषयश्च समागताः॥
en: Bhimasena said That Shikhandin, the son of Drupada who is born for the destruction ((of Bhishma) as it is used to be said, O chief among kings, by the assembled Siddhas and Rishis,

sa: निर्ममा निरहङ्कारा निर्द्वन्द्वाः संयतेन्द्रियाः। ध्यानयोगपराश्चैव तत्र गच्छन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Men who enjoy heaven suffer great misery and extreme regret in this world. Therefore I do not desire (to go to) heaven.

sa: अयं त्वन्यो गुणः श्रेष्ठश्च्युतानां स्वर्गतो मुने। शुभानुशययोगेन मनुष्येषूपजायते॥
en: O Rishi, this is another of the attributes of the fallen that by reason of their merits, they take birth amongst men.

sa: न वर्तयन्त्याहुतिभिस्ते नाष्यमृतभोजनाः। तथा दिव्यशरीरास्ते न च विग्रहमूर्तयः॥
en: They do not live on oblations or on ambrosia. They possess such celestial forms that they cannot be perceived by the senses.

sa: तस्य पूजार्थमद्यैव संविधत्स्व परंतप। सभाः पथि विधीयन्तां सर्वकामसमन्विताः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, prepare for his worship from this moment and erect pavilions on the way filled with all necessary articles.

sa: द्रष्टारो हि कुरवस्तं समेता महात्मानं शत्रुहणं वरेण्यम्। ब्रुवन्तं वाचमनृशंसरूपां वृष्णिश्रेष्ठं मोहयन्तं मदीयान्॥
en: The sons of Kuru, assembled together, will see that worshipful slayer of his foes, of high soul, that foremost among the Vrishnis, speaking words full of benevolence and thus winning over my party.

sa: तं सम्मथितसर्वाङ्गं मांसपिण्डोपमं कृतम्। कृष्णाया दर्शयामास भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: The highly-powerful Bhimasena then showed him to Krishna; all his limbs were crushed and he was reduced into a ball of flesh.

sa: जघनार्धे विराटश्च याज्ञसेनिश्च सौमकिः। सुधर्मा कुन्तिभोजश्च धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चात्मजाः॥
en: In the rear were, Virata and the son of Yagasena of the Somaka race, Sudharman and Kuntibhoja and the sons of Dhrishtadyumna,

sa: तत्र दिव्यानि पद्मानि पञ्चवर्णानि भारत। षट्पदैरुपगीतानि प्रफुल्लानि सहस्रशः॥
en: And saw there, O son of Bharata thousands of beautiful lotuses of five colours full blown and around which the bees hummed.

sa: बाहू च दीर्घान् प्रविकीर्य मूर्धजान् महाभुजो वारणतुल्यविक्रमः। गतेन भूमि प्रतिकम्पयंस्तदा विराटमासाद्य सभासमीपतः॥
en: That long armed one, having the gait like that of an elephant, with long and abundant tissues hanging about, came to Virata shaking the earth with his tread and stood in his court.

sa: पातितो भुवि भीमस्तु कीचकेन बलीयसा। उत्पपाताथ वेगेन दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः॥
en: Being thrown on the ground by the powerful Kichaka, Bhima rose up again with force, like Yama with mace in his hands.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच दुर्योधनं मोक्षयित्वा पाण्डुपुत्रा महाबलाः। किमकार्षुर्वने तस्मिंस्तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Janamejaya said : After having rescued Duryodhana, what did the mighty Pandavas do in that forest? You should tell me all this.

sa: नाश्रेयानीश्वरो विग्रहाणां नाश्रेयान् वै गीतशब्दं शृणोति। नाश्रेयान् वै सेवते माल्यगन्धान् न चाप्यश्रेयाननुलेपनानि॥
en: Deserted by the goddess of fortune people never win victory in battle; unfortunate people never hear the sound of music, unfortunate people never enjoy garlands and fragrance and unfortunate people (never enjoy) ungents.

sa: कृतसम्प्रत्ययस्तस्याः कीचकः काममोहितः। नाजानाद् दिवसं यान्तं चिन्तयानः समागमम्॥
en: Like the wick of a burning lamp at the time of its expiration. Placing perfect confidence in her, Kichaka, possessed by lust,

sa: भीमसेनं च संशान्तं दृष्ट्वा परमदुर्मनाः। अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा वाक्यमुवाचेदं मनस्विनी॥
en: Seeing Bhimasena inclined towards peace, that intelligent lady with a sense of her wrongs said these words with tears in her eyes:

sa: या तु त्यागेन शान्तिः स्यात् तदृते वध एव सः। संशयाच्च समुच्छेदाद् द्विषतामात्मनस्तथा॥
en: The peace that we can obtain by foregoing our claim to the kingdom is in effect the same thing as the total extinction of ourselves and the enemy or the uncertainly of victory.

sa: किमब्रवीन्महाबाहुः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। भीमसेनार्जुनो वापि कृष्णो वा प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Of long arms, the foremost among all wielders of weapons, say and what did Bhimasena and Arjuna and what did Krishna say?

sa: ततस्तव भवित्रीयं पुत्राणां जननी शुभा। अरणीव हुताशानां योनिरायतलोचना॥
en: Then will this blessed maiden with large eyes, be the mother of your children as the fire stick is mother of fire.

sa: ततः समुद्धृतप्राणं गतश्वासं हतप्रभम्। निर्विचेष्टं शरीरं तद् बभूवाप्रियददर्शनम्॥
en: The life being taken out, the body deprived of breath, destitute of lustre and devoid of motion, became disagreeable to the eye.

sa: यम उवाच निवर्त गच्छ सावित्री कुरुष्वास्यौर्ध्वदेहिकम्। कृतं भर्तुस्त्वयाऽऽनृण्यं यावद् गम्यं गतं त्वया॥
en: Yama said: Go back, O Savitri and perform the last rites of your husband. Your debt to your husband is discharged. You have come as far as is possible (for you) to do.

sa: चतुरोऽपश्यत नृपस्तेषां मध्ये पपात ह। प्रतर्दनो वसुमनाः शिबिरौशीनरोऽष्टकः॥
en: At this time he saw four kings and fell among them. They were Pratardana, Vasumanas, Shibi the son of Ushinara and Ashtaka.

sa: मुहूर्तात् प्रतिबुद्धस्तु सुपर्णो गमनेप्सया। अथ भ्रष्टतनूजाङ्गमात्मानं ददृशे खगः॥
en: After a moment Suparna awoke with the desire of departing and the wanderer of the sky saw himself deprived of his wings.

sa: नित्यशश्चार्जवं तस्मिन् स्थितिस्तस्यैव च ध्रुवा। संक्षेपतस्तपोवृद्धैः शीलवृद्धश्च कथ्यते॥
en: To be brief, men of great asceticism and of high character say that he (Satyavana) is ever plain and firm in honour.

sa: तदलं ज्वलितं घोरं लक्ष्मणः शरमाहितम्। अतिकायाय चिक्षेप कालदण्डमिवान्तकः॥
en: And even as the reaper hurled his rod, did Lakşmaņa hurl that weapon inspired with divine energy, dreadful and aflame, at Atikaya.

sa: विदुर उवाच राजन् नि:संशयं श्रेयो वाच्यस्त्वमसि बान्धवैः। न त्वशुश्रूषमाणे वै वाक्यं सम्प्रतिष्ठिति॥
en: Vidura said : O king, there is no doubt your friends have spoken to you what is good for you. But as you don't listen to their words, they find no place here,

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थस्य चादूरात् समाजग्मुर्महारथाः। व्यगर्हयंश्च संगम्य भवन्तं कुरुभिः सह॥
en: And when not far from Indraprastha there assembled together the car-warriors and having joined together, they blamed you along with the Kurus.

sa: स संधाय महातेजास्तं बाणं सहसोत्सृजत्। तेन सौमित्रिमायान्तमाजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Then aiming that arrow, that highly powerful one suddenly shot it; and with that, rushing on, hit Sumitra's son in the chest.

sa: ये तु तद्भाविता लोके ह्येकान्तित्वं समास्थिताः। एतदभ्यधिकं तेषां यत् ते तं प्रविशन्त्यत्॥
en: Those persons in this world who, filled with His spirit, become fully and conclusively devoted to him, acquire much higher end, for they succed in entering Him and becoming merged in his self.

sa: समन्ताच्छङ्कुनिनदं पाण्डुसेनाकरोत् तदा। शत्रुसेनाध्वनि श्रुत्वा तावका ह्यनदन् भृशम्॥
en: Then the Pandava troops simultaneously blew their conchs. Hearing that sound of challenge emitted by the enemy, your own troops shouted aloud.

sa: विकर्णस्य ततो भल्लान् प्रेषयामास भारत। चतुर्दश रथश्रेष्ठो घोरानाशीविषोपमान॥
en: Thereafter, O Bharata, that foremost of carwarrior, hurled at Vikarna fourteen mortal broad-headed shafts that looked like snakes of most virulent venom.

sa: पुनर्यथागतं जग्मुः सर्वभक्षश्च सोऽभवत्॥ भृगोः शापान्महाभाग यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना।
en: They then returned to their respective abodes. Agni also, from Bhrigu's curse, became an cater of everything as said by the Brahmavadin.

sa: तेऽविदूराद् धनुष्पाणिं यज्ञियस्य हयस्य च। बीभत्सुं प्रत्यपद्यन्त पदातिनमवस्थितम्॥
en: Advancing against Bibhatsu who waited on foot, armed with his bow, upon the sacrificial horse, they attacked him from a near point.

sa: तस्मात्सुमन्त्रितं साधु भवन्तो मतिसत्तमाः। कार्य संप्रतिपद्यन्तामेतत्कृत्यं मतं मम॥
en: You are all gifted with good intellects: do you all unanimously settle as to what become me and conduce to my well-being.

sa: भक्ष्याद् वियोजितस्याद्य मम प्राणा विशाम्पते। विसृज्य कायमेष्यन्ति पन्थानमकुतोभयम्॥
en: O king, my life will depart today if deprived of food. Leaving my body it would fearlessly go away to other ways.

sa: असाविन्द्र इवासह्यः सात्यकिः सात्वतां पुरः। युयुत्सुरुपयात्यस्मान् क्रुद्धान्तकसमः पुरः॥
en: There advances against us Satyaki, the foremost of the Satvatas, irresistible like Indra, with view to fight like Death himself in anger.

sa: अतीवरूपसम्पन्नो न कंचिदवमन्यते। अतीव जल्पन् दुर्वाचो भवतीह विहेठकः॥
en: He, who is really very handsome, never taunts others. He, who too much vilifies others, is only considered to be a reviler.

sa: अचोद्यमानानि यथा पुष्पाणि च फलानि च। स्वकालं नातिवर्तन्ते तथा कर्म पुरा कृतम्॥
en: As the flowers and fruits of a tree, unmoved by apparent influences, never miss their proper one season, so does Karma done in a pristine existence bring about its fruits in proper time.

sa: विदितं तेन शीलं ते सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा। यथा त्वं भिक्षितः सद्भिर्ददास्येव न याचसे॥
en: This noble conduct on your part that when asked by the pious you give away to them whatsoever they ask but never beg, is known to Shakra himself and the world at large.

sa: अनुज्ञातस्त्वया वीर संश्रयेयं वनान्यहम्॥ चीरवल्कलभृद् राजन् गान्धार्या सहितोऽनया।
en: With your permission, O hero, I shall retire into the forest, clad in rags and darks, O king, along with this Gandhari.

sa: गदया निहतो भीमो मुह्यमानो महारणे॥ नाभ्यमन्यत कर्तव्यं पुत्रेणाभ्याहतस्तव।
en: Struck very forcibly by your son in that dreadful battle, Bhimasena was stupefied, and for a time knew not what to do.

sa: प्रममाथ शिनेः पौत्रं कर्णः सायकवृष्टिभिः। अमृष्यमाणो निधनं कौरव्यजलसंधयोः॥
en: First Karna, unable to endure the destruction of Jalasandha of the Kuru party, overpowered the grandson of Sini with downpours of shafts.

sa: प्रत्याचख्यौ च शाल्वोऽस्याश्चारित्रस्याभिशङ्कितः। सेयं तपोवनं प्राप्ता तापस्येऽभिरता भृशम्॥
en: Shalva, however being suspicious about her character, rejected her and she, coming to this hermitage, has become greatly bent on practicing asceticism.

sa: कामं क्रोध भयं लोभमभिद्रोहमथानृतम्। इन्द्रियाणां निरोधेन सतस्त्यजति दुस्त्यजान्॥
en: By controlling the senses, one renounces lust, anger, fear, cupidity, enmity, and falsehood, which are cternal and, therefore, highly difficult to renounce.

sa: स सर्वदोषनिर्मुक्तस्ततः पश्यति तत्परम्। मनो मनसि संधाय पश्यन्नात्मानमात्मनि॥
en: Such a man, freed from all faults, then sces the Highest, concentrating the mind within the mind and sceing self in self.

sa: दुर्मुखो दशभिर्बाणैस्तथा दुःशासनोऽष्टभिः। चित्रसेनश्च शैनेय द्वाभ्यां विव्याध मारिष॥
en: o sire, Durmukha then pierced Sini's grandson with ten shafts, Dushasana pierced him with eight and Chitrasena with a couple of arrows.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यानङ्गिराः क्षत्रधर्मानुतथ्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। मान्धात्रे यौवनाश्वाय प्रीतिमानभ्यभाषत॥
en: Bhishma said That best of all persons conversant with the Vedas, viz., Utatthya of Angirasa's family, discoursed gladly to Yuvanashva's son Mandhatri.

sa: साध्वर्थमभिसंधाय क्रोधान्मोहाच्च साहसात्। तातस्य यदतिक्रान्तं प्रत्याहरतु तद् भवान्॥
en: Do you, intent upon bringing about good, redeem the wrong that has been done by our sire through anger, ignorance and recklessness.

sa: तवापमानप्रभवः क्रोधोऽयमतुलो मम। न शक्यते धारयितुं लवणाम्भ इवोल्बणम्॥
en: Arising from this your humiliating censure, my wrath is beyond compare. I can not bear it, like salt-water cast on a sore.

sa: हेमरूप्यप्रसृष्टानां वाससां शिल्पिनिर्मिताः॥ नानावर्णा रथे भान्ति श्वसनेन प्रकम्पिताः।
en: Many flags of diverse colours and embroidered with gold, made by skillful artisans and shining on Arjuna's car shaken by the wind.

sa: कृष्णश्च भृशसंतप्तो दृष्ट्वा पार्थं विचेतनम्। आश्वासयत् सुहृद्याभिर्वाग्भिस्तत्र धनंजयम्॥
en: Then seeing Partha losing consciousness, Krishna was very much distressed; and then he began to comfort Dhananjaya with words soothing and agreeable.

sa: तस्य विक्षिपतश्चापं रथे विष्टभ्य तिष्ठतः॥ अश्रूयत धनुघोंषो विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः।
en: Proudly seated on his car, as he stretched his bow, the twang that was heard resembled the rumble of the roaring thunder.

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण संनादं वने मदविवर्धनम्। पुष्पिताग्रेषु वृक्षेषु द्विजानामवकूजताम्॥
en: Hear, O Laksmana, the maddening notes of those birds sitting on the tops of the flowery trees and setting up their melody.

sa: पानीयं वा निरायासं स्वाइन्नं वा भयोत्तरम्। विचार्य खलु पश्यामि तत्सुखं यत्र निर्वृतिः॥
en: Simple food and drink got without effort, and rich food procured with fear, widely differ from each other. Thinking of these two, I hold that there is happiness where there is not anxiety.

sa: ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयित्वा च निश्कान् दत्त्वा पृथक् पृथक्। गाश्च वासांसि च पुन: समाभाष्य परस्परम्॥ प्रज्वाल्य कृष्णवनिमुपागम्य रणव्रतम्। तस्मिन्नग्नौ तदा चक्रुः प्रतिज्ञां दृढनिश्चयाः॥
en: Those heroes having gratified the Brahmanas by giving them golden coin separately and also kine and garments and having addressed one another in loving words, and having kindled the fire, took that oath in the field of battle; then in the presence of that fire they took that oath with a great firmness of resolution.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तमेकं समरे विचरन्तमभीतवत्। सहिताः सर्वराजानः परिवठ्ठः समन्ततः॥
en: Seeing him career along through the field of battle, like one fearless, all the monarchs uniting together encompassed him on all sides.

sa: पार्श्वे भीमं पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशं पश्यस्व शङ्ख देवदत्त सुघोषम्। अभीषुहस्तस्य जनार्दनस्य विगाहमानस्य चमूं परेषाम्॥
en: Alongside him, behold, there, his conch Devadatta to thundering blare and resembling a white sheet of cloud. Behold there, Janaradana, reins in hand, making his way into the centre of the hostile divisions.

sa: तेषां षष्टिशतानन्यान् प्रामथ्नात् पाण्डवः शरैः। ते स्म भीताः पलायन्ते व्याघ्रात् क्षुद्रमृगा इव॥
en: The of Pandu consumed sixty thousands of the these and other warriors, with his arrows; and then the rest greatly frightened, began to fly away like smaller animals flying away from the tiger.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां च वेश्मानि नानादेशसमीयुषाम्। कारयामास कौन्तेयो विधिवत् तान्यनेकशः॥
en: The son of Kunti also caused many palaces to be duty erected for Brahmanas who were expected to come from various kingdoms.

sa: श्रुत्वैतच्च वचो रामः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्। किंनिमित्तमभूद् वैरं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Hearing these words, Rāma said to Sugrīva, What for arose hostility between yourself and Vāli? I wish to hear this (related) faithfully.

sa: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे भीष्मरक्षार्थमुद्यताः। प्रत्युद्ययुः पाण्डुसेनां सहसैन्या नराधिप॥
en: So also, O ruler of men, your warriors anxious for protecting Bhishma, rushed against the Pandava host, supported by their respective divisions.

sa: नक्षत्रेषु प्रशस्तेषु मुहूर्तेषु च तद्विदः। निवेशान् स्थापयामासुर्भरतस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Under an auspicious star and at a favourable hour, men well up in the work set the encampment of the high-souled Bharata.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा तं द्रोणः शरवातैरवाकिरत्। सारथाश्वध्वजं तीक्ष्णैः प्रहसन् वैससारथिम्॥
en: Speaking these words only, Drona with myriads of sharp arrows, covered Arjuna, is chariot, steeds, standards and charioteer, similing all the while.

sa: भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्नागायुतबलो महान्। कथं स्म युधि शक्येत विजेतुममरैरपि॥
en: Can the powerful Bhimsena of strong arms possessing the might of ten thousand elephants be vanquished in battle even by the immortals?

sa: राक्षसं तु विरूपाक्षं महावीर्यपराक्रमम्। मध्यमेऽस्थापयद्गुल्मे बहुभिः सह राक्षसैः॥
en: And he posted in the middle in the garrison the Raksasa, Virupaksa, endowed with exceeding prowess and energy, backed by countless rākşasas.

sa: फलाहारेषु सर्वेषु गतेष्वथ सुतेषु वै। रेणुका स्नातुमगमत् कदाचिन्नियतव्रता॥
en: Once upon a time when her sons had all gone away to gathering fruits, Renuka of rigid vows went to bathe. saw

sa: कुञ्जराश्च खगोष्ट्राश्च गोऽश्वाश्च मृगपक्षिणः। बभूवुः सुभृतास्तत्र नातो ह्यन्यमकल्पयम्॥
en: And elephants, and asses, camels, kine and horses, and beats and birds, being fed their fill, did not hunger after anything else.

sa: दण्डेनोपनतं शत्रुमनुगृहणाति यो नरः। स मृत्युमुपगृहणीयाद् गर्भमश्वतरी यथाः॥
en: The man, who trusts his enemy who is already under his control, invites his own death as a mule by her conception.

sa: भागिनेयान् वयस्यांश्च तथा सम्बन्धिबान्धवान्। उत्सृज्योत्सृज्य गच्छन्ति त्वरिता जीवितेप्सवः॥
en: Some their nephews, their companions and their friends and some their relatives, fled in all quickness, desirous of saving their own lives.

sa: प्रहसन् देवकीपुत्रमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। एष प्रयात्याधिरथिः सात्यकेः स्यन्दनं प्रति॥
en: Said these words to the son of Devaki with a simile-“(Behold!) the son of Adhiratha is making for the car of Satyaki.

sa: शक्र उवाच चण्डालयोनौ जातेन नावाप्यं वै कथंचन। अन्यं कामं वृणीष्व त्वं मा वृथा तेऽस्त्वयं श्रमः॥ एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु भृशं शोकपरायणः। अध्यतिष्ठद्गयां गत्वा सोऽङ्गुष्ठेन शतं समाः॥
en: Shakra said One born as a Chandala cannot, by any means, acquire the dignity of a Brahmana. Do you, therefore, name some other boon so that all this labour of yours may not prove futile! Thus addressed by the king of the celestials, Matanga became filled with grief. He went to Gaya, and passed there a century of years, standing all the while on one foot.

sa: यो हि भोज्ये पुरुकार्यो यानेषु शयनेषु च। भूषणेषु च सोऽस्माभिर्बालो युधि पुरस्कृतः॥
en: He who was a mere boy and who should have been indulged with good food, conveyance, beds and ornaments, alas, even such a boy was placed by us in the thick of battle!

sa: सुपुष्पितांस्तु पश्यैतान् कर्णिकारान् समन्ततः। हाटकप्रतिसंछन्नान् नरान् पीताम्बरानिव ॥
en: Behold, the Karņikāras covered with flowers appear on all sides like to human beings decorated with golden ornaments and wearing yellow cloths.

sa: अब्रवीदुशना काव्यो देवयानीं यदावहम्। नेयमाह्वयितव्या ते शयने वार्षपर्वणी॥
en: Ushanas, the son of Kavi, however, commanded me when I was married to Devayani that Vrishaparva's daughter shall not be my bed.

sa: विस्फारयन् धनुः कर्णस्तस्थौ भारत दुर्मनाः। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम राधेयस्य पराक्रसम्॥
en: O Bharata, Karna with a cheerless heart stood before Bhimasena, stretching his bow. Then we beheld the wonderful prowess of Radha's son.

sa: पक्षिणश्च महाघोरं व्याहरन्तो विबभ्रषुः। सप्रभचोदितः सूर्यो निष्प्रभः समपद्यत॥
en: The sun that had risen in all splendor, now became bedimmed in effulgence; and dreadful winds began to blow portending ominous results.

sa: स पार्थिवो नित्यममर्षितस्तदा महारथः शिक्षितवत् परिभ्रमन्। अताडयत् पाण्डवमग्रतः स्थितं स विह्वलाङ्गो जगतीमुपास्पृशत्॥
en: That angry king and great car-warrior then, moving about with great skill, great skill, struck Bhimasena who was before him. Thereat, the son of Pandu, with weakened limbs, dropped down on the Earth.

sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे॥
en: Fix your heart on Me, become My devotee, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me, you will then come to Me. I tell you the truth, for you are very dear to Me.

sa: तस्मिन्नपरते शब्दे भीमसेनोऽब्रवीदिदम्। प्रगृह्य रुचिरं दिव्यं भुजं चन्दनचर्चितम्॥
en: When the noise was silenced, Bhimasena, waving his strong and well armed arms smeared with sandal paste, thus spoke (in the assembly).

sa: तामिन्द्रसेनस्त्वरितोऽभिसृत्य रथादवप्लुत्य ततोऽभ्यधावत्। प्रोवाच चैनां वचनं नरेन्द्र धात्रेयिकामन्तितरस्तदानीम्॥
en: Then descending from the car and quickly approaching Dhatreyika, who was then greatly stricken with grief, Indrasena, O king, asked her (saying).

sa: स तीर्त्वा सरयूपारं दण्डस्तस्य कराच्च्युतः। गोव्रजे बहुसाहस्र पपातोक्षणसंनिधौ॥
en: The rod, hurled off his hands, fell on the other side of the river Sarayū in the midst of many thousand bullocks.

sa: संसरन्तमपि प्रेतं विषमेष्वेकपातिनम्। भावान्वेति भर्तारं सततं या पतिव्रता॥
en: When the husband goes to the land of Yama, leaving this world, it is the devoted wife only that accompanies him there.

sa: असौ हि राक्षसः शेते शरेणाभिहतो मया। मृगरूपेण येनाहमाश्रमादपवाहितः॥
en: That Rākṣasa lie low, being wounded by my shafts—that had drawn me away from the asylum wearing the form of a deer.

sa: वक्ष्यन्ति मामधर्मज्ञं त्यक्ष्यन्ति सुहृदो जनाः। ता वाचः सुहृदः श्रुत्वा संज्वरिष्यन्ति मे भृशम्॥
en: They will even call me sinful. My kinsmen and friends will renounce me. However, hearing the words I speak, my kinsmen and friends will surely succeed in vigorously crossing the difficulties of life.

sa: यावच्च राजा ध्रियते धृतराष्ट्रो जनार्दन। न्यस्तशस्त्रा वयं ते वाप्युपजीवाम माधव। अप्रदेयं पुरा दत्तं राज्यं परवतो मम॥
en: O Janardana, so long as the position of a king is held by Dhritarashtra we shall live as his dependents with swords laid aside, O Madhava; this kingdom which ought not to have been given away was given away when I depended on others.

sa: षट्सहस्रान् हयान् वीरन् पुनर्दशशतान् वरान्॥ प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः।
en: Six thousand brave warriors and many other Kshatriyas were dispatched by that foremost of Kshatriya Arjuna as to the abode of Death.

sa: भुज्यतामिति तेनोक्ताः कृष्णभीमधनंजयाः। जरासंधेन कौरव्य कृष्णेन विकृतं कृतम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, when Bhima, Dhananjaya and Krishna were asked by Jarasandha to eat, that request was refused by this Krishna.

sa: तानपास्य शरान् मुक्ताशरसंधैः प्रतापवान्॥ सहदेवो महाराज धनुश्चिच्छेद संयुगे।
en: Counteracting those arrows shot by Subala's son with another downpour the brave Sahadeva, O king, sundered his antagonist's blow in that battle.

sa: अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि महदाख्यानमुत्तमम्। सुरभ्याश्चैव संवादमिन्द्रस्य च विशाम्पते।॥
en: O king, I shall relate to you in this connection that excellent and best of stories, the conversation between Indra and Surabhi.

sa: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः पञ्चालान् भरतर्षभ। शिनेर्नप्ता महाबाहुरन्वपद्यत सात्यकिः॥
en: At those sounds and Panchalas, O foremost of Bharata's race, were filled with fear. Then Satyaki, the grandson of Shini, came there.

sa: सात्वतौ च महावी? धन्विनौ रथिनां वरौ। अन्योन्यमभिधावेतां शस्त्रप्रवरधारिणौ॥
en: Those two bowmen, those two foremost of car-warriors roared like lions and met each other, both being armed with best of weapons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेन विक्रममाणेन ऊरुवेगसमीरितम्। वनं सवृक्षविटपं व्याघूर्णितमिवाभवत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : By the force of that mighty (heroes') breast, the forest with its trees and their branches appeared to tremble,

sa: धर्मराजोऽपि सम्प्रेक्ष्य धृष्टद्युम्नवृकोदरौ। मूर्ध्नि चैतावुपाघ्राय प्रहृष्टः शिबिरं ययौ॥
en: The very virtuous king Yudhishthira also seeing Dhrishtadyumna and Vrikodara, smelt their heads, and with a delighted heart repaired to his camps.

sa: तदाहृत्य च तां चक्रे सोऽसुरोऽप्रतिमा सभाम्। विश्रुतां त्रिषु लोकेषु दिव्यां मणिमयीं शुभाम्॥
en: Bringing them away, the Asura (Maya) built with them a matchless assembly-hall. It was celebrated throughout the three worlds, it was beautiful, it was celestials, and it was full of gems and jewels.

sa: बाहुभ्यामनुदात्तौ च विश्वे भूतानि चैव ह। एतान् सष्ट्वा ततः पञ्च पितृणामसृजत् सुतान्॥
en: And from his two arms and hymns Udatta and Anudatta. He also created the mind and the five senses and other creatures. Having created these he produced the five sons of the Pitris,

sa: अनड्वाहं सुव्रतं यो ददाति हलस्य वोढारमनन्तवीर्यम्। धुरन्धरं बलवन्तं युवानं प्राप्नोति लोकान् दशधेनुदस्य॥
en: He who gives a fine, strong, powerful and young bullock which is capable of drawing the plough and of carrying burdens goes to the region obtained by men who give away ten kine.

sa: अकस्मात् प्रक्रिया नृणामकस्माच्चापकर्षणम्। शुभाशुभे महत्त्वं च प्रकर्तुं बुद्धिलाघवम्॥
en: The prosperity of men, as also their downfall, originates of itself. Prosperity and adversity, and greatness, all originate from weakness of understanding.

sa: कर्तारमपि लोकानां शूरं करुणवेदिनम्। अज्ञानादवमन्येरन् सर्वभूतानि लक्ष्मण ॥
en: For this it is that people through ignorance disregard the ever kind Almighty-the lord of creatures and the best of the celestials.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अङ्गानां रूपसौभाग्यं प्रियं चैव कथं भवेत्। धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तः सुखभागी कथं भवेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said How, O grandfather does one acquire beauty of form and prosperity and sweetness of disposition? How, indeed, does one acquire religious meril and wealth and pleasure? How does one win happiness?

sa: अमर्षवशमापन्नस्तव पुत्रमपीडयत्। पीडितं नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रा महारथाः॥
en: Under the influence of wrath began to afflict your son severely. Beholding the king thus afflicted, your other sons all mighty carwarriors.

sa: ब्राह्मणांस्तोषयेद् यस्तु तुष्यन्ते तस्य देवताः। वचनाच्चापि विप्राणां स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: The celestials themselves are gratified with that man who gratifies the Brahmanas. At the command of a Brahmana a man obtains heaven.

sa: तावन्योन्यं महाराज ततक्षाते शरैर्भृशम्। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनौ क्रोधाद् विस्फार्य कार्मुके॥
en: (And), O great king, their eyes blood-shot in rage and drawing their bows powerfully, those two (heroes) began to mangle each other.

sa: नदन्प्रतपनो घोरो नलं सोऽभ्यनुधावत। नलः प्रपनस्याशु पातयामास चक्षुषी॥ भिन्नगात्रः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा।
en: Then the terrific Pratapana, roaring, rushed at Nala; and thereat Nala, with his body pierced with sharp shafts by that swift handed Rākşasa, plucked out Pratapana's eyes, and cast them to the earth.

sa: तेषु भूतानि मुह्यन्ति महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु। शब्दस्पर्शनरूपेषु रसगन्धक्रियासु च॥
en: In these five great clements, in the matter of the operations of sound, touch, colour, tasie, and smell, all creatures become deluded.

sa: तस्यैकां पर्णबहुलां शाखां भङ्कत्वासुशोभिताम्। रामस्यास्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद सराघवः॥
en: There at tearing off a beautiful bough full of leaves, Sugrīva spread it (on the earth), and then sat down with Rāghava.

sa: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्यवर्णं महारथम्। सदश्वैः शबलैर्युक्तमाचचक्षेऽथ दूषणः॥
en: As he said this, Dūşaņa brought his great car hued like the sun, yoked with excellent steeds of various colours. sons. were

sa: तथाविष्टमथो ज्ञात्वा ऋशयो देवतास्तथा। स्तुवन्तः शक्रमीशानं तथा प्राचोदयन्त्रपि॥
en: Knowing the enemy to be thus possessed, the Rishis and gods lauded both Shakra and Ishana, and began to urge the former.

sa: तेजोमयो नित्यमयः पुराणो लोकाननन्तानभयानुपैति। भूतानि यस्मान्न वसन्ते कदाचित्स भूतानां न त्रसते कदाचित्॥
en: Endued with effulgence as also with the principle of eternity, Sentiency is without a beginning. It wins infinite regions of eternal happiness. He whom no creature fears, has never to fear any creature.

sa: कुण्डलाभ्यामुभाभ्यां च भाति वक्रं सुभीषणम्। पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतः परिपूर्णो निशाकरः॥
en: With his pair of ear-rings, his charming yet terrific countenance shine like the full Moon entering into Punarvasu.* *The seventh lunar asterism.

sa: स चतुर्णामुपायानां द्वितीयमुपवर्णयन्। भेदयामास तान् सर्वान् वानरान् वाक्यसम्पदा॥
en: He, wealthy in words, laying under contribution the second of the four means,* had created division among those monkeys. *Referred to above.

sa: शिष्यो मम सखा चैव प्रियोऽस्याहं प्रियश्च मे। युयुधानः सहायो मे प्रमथिष्यति कौरवान्॥
en: He is both my pupil and friend. I am dear to him and he is dear to me. And if Yuyudhana renders me help, I can then crush the whole Kuru host completely.

sa: पुनश्चेदीदृशीं वाचं मत्समीपे वदिष्यसि॥ शिरस्ते पोथयिष्यामि गदया वज्रकल्पया।
en: If you again speak such words before re, I shall knock down your head with a mace resembling the bolt of heaven.

sa: पूरितः शरजालेन धनुर्मुक्तेन संयुगे। महागिरिरिवाकम्प्यः काकुत्स्थो न प्रकम्पते॥
en: And covered with vollies of shafts discharged from (Ravana's) bow in the conflict, Kākutstha like to a mighty mountain did not shake.

sa: स शोणितसमादिग्धः समरे लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। दृष्टः फुल्ल इवारण्ये सुमहान्किशुकदुमः॥
en: Thereat in that encounter Lakşmaņa's elder brother, with his body bathed in blood, appeared like a mighty Kinśuka tree in a forest.

sa: ततोऽन्योन्यं सुसंरब्धौ तावुभौ रामरावणौ। शरान्धकारे समरे नोपलक्षयतां तदा।९।।
en: In the darkness spread by the arrows (discharged), Rama and Ravana both fired with wrath could not be discovered of each other.

sa: अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्। पश्यन्निदं महाप्राज्ञः क्षत्ता राजानमुक्तवान्॥
en: And with his face full of tears and in "Anticipating all this, the greatly wise Kshatta (Vidura) said to the king (Dhritarashtra).

sa: पुनश्चापि महाकायः शतशीर्षः शतोदरः॥ व्यदृश्यत महाबाहुर्मैनाक इव पर्वतः।
en: Next he was seen to assume a huge form with a hundred heads and hundred stomachs and looked like the Mainaka mountain.

sa: पञ्चालान् सृञ्जयान् मत्स्यान् केकयांश्च नराधिप। द्रोणोऽजयन्महाबाहुः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, the mighty-armed Drona vanquished hundreds and thousands of the Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas and the Kekayas.

sa: सात्वतेनैवमाक्षिप्तः पार्षतः परुषाक्षरम्॥ संरब्धं सात्यकिं प्राह संक्रुद्धः प्रहसन्निव।
en: Thus reproached by that scion of the Satvata race, Prisata's son inspired with wrath, addressed these harsh words to the enraged Satyaki.

sa: ततः कृतस्वस्त्ययनो रथमारुह्य रावणः। त्रैलोक्यविजयाकांक्षी ययौ यत्र धनेश्वरः॥
en: Then, having performed Svastyayana, Rāvana, ascending his car, went to where the lord of riches was, bent on conquering the three worlds.

sa: अथान्तरिक्षे भूतानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। जज्ञेऽथ जयसंनादो गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि। ७५॥
en: And in the sky there arose the victorious shouts of all beings and high souled saints, and also of Gandharvas and Apsarās.

sa: ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः। गन्धं माल्यं महद्भक्ष्यामादाय सहसा ययुः॥
en: And desired by Rāvana, those feeding on flesh and blood went off hurriedly taking perfumes and wreaths and a mass of food.

sa: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शुभा॥ अगस्त्यस्याश्रमश्चैव दृश्यते कदलीवृतः।
en: Do you behold there the beautiful and sacred river Godāvarī having clear water and the hermitage of Agastya, surrounded by plantain trees.

sa: बालेन जातमात्रेण क्षुधार्तेन महात्मना। भक्षितानि सहस्राणि प्रजानां सुबहून्यपि॥
en: As soon as this high-souled one was born and was a babe, he began to devour up countless creatures by the thousand.

sa: अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्टवानाप्तदक्षिणैः। अग्निहोत्रेण संस्कार केन त्वं न तु लप्स्यसे॥
en: Having performed the Agnishtoma and other sacrifices with Dakşinăs (dispensed, why had not you attained purity by means of the sacrificial fire?

sa: ततो गवाक्षः शरभो हनूमानङ्गदस्तथा। शैलशृङ्गाणि शैलाभा गृहीत्वा द्वारमभ्ययुः॥
en: Then Gavākṣa and Sarabha and Hanumān and Angada, themselves endowed with the splendour of mountain-summits, taking up mountain-tops, drew towards the gateway.

sa: सबले सागरं तीर्णे रामे दशरथात्मजे। अमात्यौ रावणः श्रीमानब्रवीच्छुकसारणौ॥
en: On Dasaratha's son, Rama, having crossed the Ocean with his forces, the graceful Răvaņa addressed his two counsellors, Suka and Sarana, saying.

sa: पुनरेवाथ तं रामो रथस्थं राक्षसाधिपम्। ललाटे परमास्त्रेण सर्वास्त्रकुशलोऽभिनत्॥
en: Again Rāma skilled in all weapons, from a powerful weapon discharged arrows at the sovereign of the Raksasas mounted on his car.

sa: इति संजल्पमानां तां रामार्थे शोककर्शिताम्। अश्रुसम्पूर्णवदनामुवाच हनुमान् कपिः॥
en: Saying this she was overwhelmed with grief on Rāma's account, and Hanumān again spoke to her having her countenance bathed in tears.

sa: मालेधनुश्च्युता बाणाः कार्तस्वरविभूषिताः। विविशुहरिमासाद्य क्रौञ्चं पत्ररथा इव ॥
en: Like birds entering the Krauñca mountain, the arrows discharged from Mali's bow, graced with gold, hit Hari and entered (into his body).

sa: अहं प्रस्रवणस्थाय राघवायाद्य मैथिलि। प्रापयिष्यामि शक्राय हव्यं हुतमिवानलः॥
en: I shall restore you to-day, O Maithili, to Rāghava on the mount Prasravaņa, like to fire carrying to Indra, the sacrificial offerings.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। आगम्य गगने तस्थुर्द्रष्टुकामास्तदद्भुतम्॥
en: Then the deities and Gandharvas, the Siddhas and the prime saints, appearing in the heavens, stood there, eager to behold this wonder.

sa: अर्जुनाय तु तत्कर्म रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः। क्रीडमानाय कथितं पुरुषैर्भयविह्वलैः॥
en: Thereupon the emissaries, stricken with fear, went to the sporting king and communicated to him the proceedings of Rāvana and his iministers.

sa: तेनैव तोरणेनाथ यक्षस्तेनाभिताडितः। नादृश्यत तदा यक्षो भस्मीकृततनुस्तदा ॥
en: And on being struck by the same gate-way, the Yakșa ceased to be seen, his body having then been consumed to ashes.

sa: तस्य कृद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतनशुबिन्दवः। दीपाभ्यामिव दीप्ताभ्यां साचिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः॥
en: And from the eyes of that infuriated one fell drops of tears as drop from a flaming lamp drops of burning oil.

sa: प्रत्यवेक्ष्य तु ताम्राक्षः सुघोरो घोरदर्शनः। दीनो दीनस्वरान्सांस्तानुवाच निशाचरान्॥
en: And eyeing round, that copper-eyed and dreadful one of a terrific aspect, distressed, in a piteous voice addressed all the night-rangers, saying.

sa: अनयोपधया राजन्भूयः शोकानुबन्धया। अकामा त्वद्वशं सीता नष्टनाथा गमिष्यति॥
en: By this deceit, О king, working powerfully through Sītā's sorrow, she albeit unwilling, shall, having lost her lord, come under your control.

sa: इत्येतद्वाक्यमादाय राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः। निर्ययुस्ते रथैः शीघे नानीकैश्च संयुताः॥
en: Hearing the speech of their lord the Rākṣasas, with a huge army and a host of cars, speedily issued out for battle.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। कपे लाघवयुक्तोऽसि मायया परया सह॥
en: Then exceedingly energetic lord of the Rākşasas said, O monkey, by virtue of your skill in illusion, you are furnished with lightness.

sa: ततो राज्ञा समादिष्टाः समुत्पत्य वलीमुखाः। जगृहुश्च वबन्धुश्च विलपन्तमनाथवत्॥
en: Thereat, commanded by the king, the monkeys, springing up, seized (Suka) and bound him, as he burst out bewailing like one forlorn.

sa: स्त्रीत्वान्न त्वं समर्थासि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम्। मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्॥
en: And because you are a female, you are not capable of crossing on my back, the main extending over a thousand leagues.

sa: स तान्वृक्षान्समासाद्य प्रतिचिच्छेद रावणः। अभ्यवर्षच्च घोरेण शरवर्षेण पावकिम्॥
en: Ravana, getting at the trees, severed them (by means of his arrows), and poured on the Firegod's son terrific showers of shafts.

sa: कार्तवीर्यभुजासक्तं तज्जलं प्राप्य निर्मलम्। कूलोपहारं कुर्वाणं प्रतिस्रोतः प्रधावति॥
en: Being obstructed by the arms of Kārtavīryarjuna and having flooded the banks with her pure waters, Narmadā flowed in an opposite direction.

sa: अपश्यत्सैनिकांश्चास्य यमस्यानुचरैः सह। यमस्य पुरुषैरुप्रै।ररूपैर्भयानकैः॥ ददर्श वध्यमानांश्च किलश्यमानांश्च देहिनः। क्रोशतश्च महानादं तीव्रनिष्टनतत्परान्॥ कृमिभिर्भक्ष्यमाणांश्च सारमेयैश्च दारुणैः। श्रोत्रायासकरा वाचो वदतश्च भयावहाः॥ संतार्यमाणान्वैतरणी बहुशः शोणितोदकाम्। वालुकासु च तप्तासु तप्यमानान्मुहुर्मुहुः॥ असिपत्रवने चैव भिद्यमानानधार्मिकान्। रौरवे क्षारनद्यां च क्षुरधारासु चैव हि ॥ पानीयं याचमानांश्च तृषितान्क्षुधितानपि। शवभूतान्कृशान्दीनान्विवर्णान्मुक्तमूर्धनान् ॥ मलपङ्कधरान्दीनान्रुक्
en: There he saw Yama's soldiery along with Yama's followers, fierce-forms, grim-visaged and terrific. And he saw corporeal beings undergoing torments and pain, and emitting loud cries and sharp shrieks; preyed on by worms and fell dogs: and uttering words capable of striking pain and terror into the heart (of the hearer): and people swimming in the Vaitarani profusely running blood; and momentarily burning with hot sands; unrighteous wights pierced in a wood of asipatra, (plunged) in Raurava, in the river of borate of soda; and (cut) with razor-edges; asking for drinks; and afflicted with hunger and thirst; converted into corpses, lean, woe-begone, and pallid with hair flowing loosely; having dust and filth (on their bodies), and running about distressfully with dry forms; on the way saw Rāva

sa: पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ । सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ स्वङ्गुलीयकलक्षितौ ॥ संवृतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ॥
en: Well developed; having equal and elegant parts; with hard joints; fraught with strength; with thumbs having nails bearing auspicious marks; having rings (on the fingers); covered; formed like bludgeons; round; resembling the trunks of elephants; cast on the white bed like to five-hooded serpents;

sa: मैथिली रक्ष्यमाणा तु राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता। ददर्श राक्षसं क्रुद्धं निस्त्रिंशवरधारिणम् ॥ तं निशम्य सनिस्त्रिंश व्यथिता जनकात्मजा। निवार्यमाणं बहुशः सुहृद्भिरनिवर्तिनम्॥ सीता दुःखसमाविष्टा विलपन्तीदमब्रवीत्। यथायं मामभिक्रुद्धः समभिद्रवति स्वयम्।। वधिष्यति सनाथां मामनाथामिव दुर्मतिः॥
en: The blameless daughter of Mithilă protected by the Rākşasis, saw the infuriated Rāvana bearing that best of blades in his hand. Seeing (Ravana) approach, sword in hand, despite the earnest entreaties of his friends, Janaka's daughter, SIta, pained and overcome by grief, said, weeping-From the way in which, wrought up with wrath, this wicked-minded one is rushing on at me personally it appears that he will slay me, who have a lord, as one who has not.

sa: अनुजो नाम तस्यैष रावणस्य विभीषणः। पृच्छ्यतां मधुरेणायं शनैर्नरपतीश्वर॥
en: He is Rāvana's younger brother, by name Vibhīşana. Let the lord of men ask him every thing at first in sweet words.

sa: ततो मैन्दस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य नयापनयकोविदः। वाक्यं वचनसंपन्नो बभाषे हेतुमुत्तरम्॥
en: There upon followed Mainda, conversant with what is right and wrong, after due deliberation, with words pregnant with words pregnant with reason.

sa: व्यशीर्यत महद्दिव्यं कवचं लक्ष्मणस्य तु। कृतप्रतिकृतान्योन्यं बभूवतुरभिद्रुतौ ॥
en: Thereat Lakşmaņa's gorgeous and mighty mail was rent in pieces. And each rushing forward was engaged in dealing blows and harrying them.

sa: इहागतं मां सहितं भवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदं विदित्वा। शून्यां पुरीं दुष्प्रसहां प्रमथ्य प्रधर्षयेयुः सहसा समेताः॥
en: Taking note of this lapse, viz., that you have all come hither with me, the wood-rangers in a body, subduing the empty city incapable of being withstood, shall suddenly put (all) to straits.

sa: अन्तःपुरनिवासिन्यः स्त्रियः सर्वगुणान्विताः। यावत्यो मम सर्वासामैश्वर्यं कुरु जानकि॥
en: O daughter of Janaka, do you exercise, your supremacy, over all my wives, living in my seraglio and gifted with all accomplishments.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान्। लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम्॥
en: Having said this, Rāma endowed with prowess, eve followed by Laksmana, stood, taking up his bow and pulling out a powerful shaft.

sa: क्लिष्टकौशेयवसनां तन्वीमप्यनलंकृताम्। त्वां दृष्ट्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रतिं नोपलभाम्यहम्॥
en: Beholding you, wearing a shattered silken cloth, slender and without any ornaments, I do not find any attachment in my own wives.

sa: विद्वताश्च भयत्रस्ता विनेदुर्मुगपक्षिणः। रक्षसां च निमित्तानि क्रूराणि प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: And agitated with fear, birds and beasts hurried (on all sides); and omens boding evil to the, Raksasas, began to appear (everywhere).

sa: क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च भल्लैश्च निशितैः शरैः। राक्षसा वानरेन्द्राणां बिभिदुः पादपाशिलाः॥
en: The Raksasas rived the trees and rocks of the foremost monkeys by means of Kșurapras and crescents and sharpened Bhallas and arrows.

sa: प्रतिकर्म च रामस्य कारयामास वीर्यवान्। लक्ष्मणस्य च लक्ष्मीवानिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः॥
en: The valiant and graceful Śatrughna the upholder of the dignity of Ikşvāku race, himself got ready the dresses for Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: सुनिविष्टं हितं वाक्यमुक्तवन्तं विभीषणम्। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं रावणः कालचोदितः॥
en: Vibhīşaņa addressing him with these excellent and auspicious words, fraught with high sense, Rāvaņa, impelled by Death, again spoke in harsh accents.

sa: आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ति जनयन्तो महद्भयम्। दीना दीनस्वराः क्रूरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः॥
en: And exciting great fear, inauspicious birds and beasts, wearing cruel looks, and in distressful guise, cry in piteous accents, facing the Sun.

sa: धिगस्तु कुब्जामसती मन्थरां पापनिश्चयाम्। यनिमित्तमिमं शोकं कौसल्या प्रतिपत्स्यते॥
en: Shame on the unchaste and hump-backed Manthara, having her heart fixed in sin, for whose sake this grief shat Rāvana's exercise Kausalya!

sa: क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षों पुरीं रावणपालिताम्। अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः॥
en: This very day with all expedition shall we surrounded on all sides by the monkeys, march towards the city governed by Rāvaņa.

sa: पत्रिणः शितधारास्ते शरा मत्कार्मुकच्युताः। आदास्यन्तेऽद्य सौमित्रे जीवितं जीवितान्तकाः॥
en: O son of Sumitrā, my feathered and sharpedged shafts shot from my bow, capable of destroying life, will today finish you up.

sa: विषाणं चास्य निष्कृष्य वालिपुत्रो महाबलः॥ देवान्तकमभिदुत्य ताडयामास संयुगे।
en: Then pulling out his tusks, the highly powerful son of Vāli, darting against Devāntaka, dealt him a blow therewith in that encounter.

sa: स ज्वालापरिवारस्तु निर्दहन्निव राक्षसम्। तेन स्पृष्टो बलवता महाप्रहरणोऽस्फुरत्॥
en: And touched by that powerful one, that mighty weapon, engist with flames, attained access of energy, and seemed to consume the Raksasa.

sa: वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्च बभूव दुमपाणिभिः। सर्वतः संवृता लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशापि वायुना॥
en: And Larkā, blocked up everywhere with powerful monkeys bearing trees in their hands, was incapable of being entered even by the Wind.

sa: बृहत्कौतूहले चास्मिन्संवृतो मुनिपुंगवा उत्पत्तिर्यादृशी दिव्या वालिसुग्रीवयोजि॥ किं चित्रं मम ब्रह्मर्षे सुरेन्द्रतपनावुभौ। जातौ वानरशार्दूलौ बलेन बलिनां वरौ॥
en: O foremost of Munis, I was greatly worked up with curiosity in this matter. I am not the least surprised to learn, O twice-born one, that those two sons of the celestials would be two highly powerful leading monkeys since their origin is divine.”

sa: अहं तु खलु सर्वान्वः समर्थयितुमुद्यतः। कुम्भकर्णस्य तु स्वप्नानेममर्थमचोदयम्॥
en: I am, for certain, going to employ you all. In consequence of Kumbhakarņa's sleep, I could not inform him of this matter.

sa: ऋषिशापाहतबलस्तदैव कपिसत्तमः। सिंहः कुञ्जररुद्धो वा आस्थितः सहितो रणे।॥
en: Due to the curse of Rşis, Hanumān devoid of might remained forestalled in the sight like a loin restrained by an elephant.

sa: विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ। काङ्कमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥
en: Endowed with victorious vigour, those heroes, never knowing to desist from fight, were eager for fame, even like Vrtra and Vasava (fighting).

sa: तमापतन्तमाकाशं दुमवर्ष प्रतापवान्। त्रिशिरानिशितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद च ननाद च ॥
en: Trisiras endowed with prowess by means of sharpened shafts cut off that descending arrowy shower in the sky and shouted (in delight).

sa: सर्वाभरणजुष्टाश्च ययुस्ताः शुभकुण्डलाः। सुग्रीवपत्न्यः सीता च द्रष्टुं नगरमुत्सुकाः॥
en: Then went Sītā and all the wives of Sugrīva decorated with all ornaments and wearing excellent Kundalas, anxious to behold the city.

sa: परश्वधधराश्चान्ये तथान्ये शूलपाणयः। ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणां संजज्ञे निःस्वनो महान्॥ तुमुलः शङ्खशब्दश्च सभां गच्छति रावणे।
en: Some of them were bearing spades and others with darts in hands. As Rāvana marched towards the court, there arose the loud blares of a thousand trumpet, and the uproarious sounds of conchs.

sa: जम्बुमालिं सुनिहतं किंकरांश्च महाबलान्। चुक्रोध रावणः श्रुत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Hearing Jambumāli as well as his exceedingly powerful servants slaughtered, Rāvana became transported with anger, and his eyes became reddened in wrath.

sa: स तेनाभिहतः क्रुद्धो नर्दनराक्षसपुंगवः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि प्लवंगानां चमूपतौ॥
en: Thereat, that foremost of Raksasas, on being attacked, flaming up into fury and uttering roars, poured showers of arrows on the monkeyleader.

sa: अद्येदानीं तवानार्ये सीते पापविनिश्चये। राक्षस्यो भक्षयिष्यन्ति मांसमेतद् यथासुखम्॥
en: O vile Sītă, O you bent on committing sin, we Rākşasīs shall today devour your flesh to the best of our satisfaction.

sa: इत्युक्ताः सीतया घोरं राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूछिताः। कांश्चिज्जग्मुस्तदाख्यातुं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: Being thus addressed angrily by Sītā, some of those Raksasis, beside themselves with ire, proceeded to relate this to the vicious-souled Ravana.

sa: आमात्यैश्च महावीर्यैर्दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। वारुणं तद्वलं सर्व क्षणेन विनिपातितम्॥
en: And in a short while that entire host of Varuņa was brought down by the highly powerful councillor of that Raksasa Daśagrīva.

sa: स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैर्महाकार्मुकनिःसृतैः। रावणेन महातेजा न प्राकम्पत राघवः॥
en: And pierced by Rāyaṇa with those ten shafts discharged from his mighty bow the exceedingly powerful Rāghava did not so much shake.

sa: तान्सर्वान्हि समादिश्य रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। मन्युशल्यं वहन्दीनः प्रविवेश स्वमालयम्॥
en: Having directed them, Ravana, lord O Rākşasas, bearing the dart of ire (in his heart), i forlorn guise entered his own mansion.

sa: मयेन दानवेन्द्रेण त्वद्भयात्सख्यमिच्छता। दुहिता तव भार्यार्थ दत्ता राक्षसपुङ्गव।७।।
en: O lord of Rākşasas, desiring your friendship out of fear, Maya, the king of Danavas, offered you his daughter for your spouse.

sa: ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरः सरथः सज्जकार्मुकः। किरशरशतै कैरभिपेदे महाबलः॥
en: Then the exceedingly powerful and heroic Durdhara mounted on a car, with his bow stringed, came forward showering innumerable arrows by hundreds.

sa: शूलैः प्रमथिताः केचित्केचित्तु परमायुधैः । परिघेराहताः केचित्केचिच्छिन्नाः परश्वधैः॥
en: Some were pierced with darts and with (other) powerful weapons; and some were wounded with bludgeons; and some were hewn with axes.

sa: मृगसिंहमुखैर्युक्तं खरैः कनकभूषितैः। आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं धूम्राक्षः खरनिःस्वनः॥
en: Then Dhūmrākṣa himself ascended a superb car, bearing faces of deer and lions decked with gold, and sending forth a loud clatter.

sa: अश्वैरश्वान्गजै गान्योधैर्योधारथै रथान्। स कपि शयामास सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान्॥
en: As the thousand-eyed Deity destroyed Asuras, the monkey destroyed steeds with steeds, elephants with elephants, warriors with warriors, and cars with cars.

sa: तथा वृक्षैर्महाकायाः पर्वताग्रेश्च वानराः। निजघ्नुस्तानि रक्षांसि नखैर्दन्तैश्च वेगिनः॥
en: The vehement monkeys (on their side) slaughtered Rākşasa with trees and tops of crags as well as with their nails and teeth.

sa: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवश्चस्खलुश्च तुरंगमाः। ध्वजाग्रे न्यपतद्गृध्रो विनेदुश्चाशिवाः शिवाः॥
en: The celestial poured down bloody rains-the course of the horses was slackened-the vultures sat on the banners and jackals emitted inauspicious cries.

sa: नूनमस्यां महाराज न देवा भोगसत्चमान्॥ विदधत्यमर श्रेष्ठास्तव बाहुबलार्जितान्।
en: O great king, forsooth, the celestials have not destined for her enjoyment all those objects which you had procured by your prowess.

sa: तमुत्पतन्तं समभिद्रवद् बली स राक्षसानां प्रवरः प्रतापवान्। रथी रथश्रेष्ठतरः किरञ्छरैः पयोधरः शैलमिवाश्मवृष्टिभिः॥
en: As he leapt up, that strong and powerful one-foremost of Raksasas-that car-warrior and the best of choice car warriors-rushed at (Hanuman), showering arrows on him, like a cloud showering hail-stones on a mountain.

sa: भुजान्विक्षिप्य शैलांश्च दुमानन्ये बभञ्जिरे। आरोहन्तश्च शृङ्गाणि गिरीणां गिरिगोचराः॥
en: Some, stretching forth their arms, were breaking the hills, and others the trees. And other were ascending the tops of the hills.

sa: वानराणां सहस्रेस्तु हनूमान्बहुभिर्वृतः। विभीषणश्च सामात्यो लक्ष्मणं त्वरितं ययौ॥
en: Surrounded by thousands of monkeys, Hanumān as well as Vibhīşaņa together with his counsellors speedily went in the wake of Lakş mana.

sa: ततो मर्मसु मर्मज्ञो मज्जयनिशिताशरान्। रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वीरो ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: That one versed in the inner sense of things, with whetted arrows pierced the vitals of Rāma and Lakşmaņa and shouted momentarily.

sa: अथवा रामरूपेण कृतान्तः स्वयमागतः। मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम्॥
en: (Methinks) Death (himself) came there in the shape of Rāma and spread illusions unconsciously for your destruction, O you of great strength.

sa: तामपश्यन् कपिस्तत्र पश्यंश्चान्या वरस्त्रियः। अपक्रम्य तदा वीरः प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: And not seeing her, that hero, having beheld other magnificent dames, coming out of that place, set about searching for Sītā (afresh).

sa: अचेष्टौ मन्दनिःश्वासौ शोणितेन परिप्लुतौ। शरजालाचितौ स्तब्धौ शयानौ शरतल्पगौ॥
en: And moveless; breathing covered with bloodpierced all over with net-works of shafts; dumb; they* were lying on the field. *Rama and Laksmana.

sa: निःश्वसन्तौ यथा सौ निश्चेष्टौ दीनविक्रमौ। रुधिरस्रावदिग्धाङ्गौ तपनीयाविव ध्वजौ॥
en: They were sighing like serpents; and were inert; and deprived of prowess; and washed in blood; and looking like to golden standards.

sa: रघुनन्दन वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां मे हितं वचः। साध्वयं यातु सौमित्रिर्बलेन महता वृतः॥ निकुम्भिलायां संप्राप्तं हन्तुं रावणिमाहवे। धनुर्मण्डलनिर्मुक्तैराशीविषविषोपमैः॥
