en: Let Sumitra's son go forth, environed by a mighty force, for slaying in battle the son of Ravana, who has gone to Nikumbhila; with shafts resembling Venomous serpents, discharged from the round* of his bow. *The bow drawn to its full stretch, becomes circular.

sa: यत्कृते चिन्तयानस्य शोकार्तस्य पितुर्मम। अस्पृष्ट्वा शयनं गात्रैस्त्रियामा याति शर्वरी॥ कृत्स्नेयं यत्कृते लङ्का नदी वर्षास्विवाकुला। सोऽयं मूलहरोऽ नर्थः सर्वेषां शमितो मया॥
en: He for whom my father was exercise with anxiety and tormented by grief, for whom my sire used to spend nights without pressing his bed, for whom this entire Lankā had resembled a river turbulent in the rainy reason, that same evil sticking by the root of all, has been dispensed his quietus by me.

sa: यथाक्रमं तैः स कपिश्च पृष्टः कार्यार्थमर्थस्य च मूलमादौ। निवेदयामास हरिश्वरस्य दूतः सकाशादहमागतोऽस्मि॥
en: And by turns questioned by them as to his mission and purpose, as well as the fundamental occasion (of his in road), that foremost of monkeys replied, “A messenger, I come (from Sugriva.)"

sa: इमामसितकेशान्तां शतपत्रनिभेक्षणाम्। सुखाहाँ दुःखितां ज्ञात्वा ममापि व्यथितं मनः॥
en: My heart is greatly pained knowing that she, having dark-blue eyes, resembling lotus petals, worthy of happiness, has been possessed by grief.

sa: रामस्य तुरगान्दीप्तैः शरैर्विव्याध रावणः। ते दिव्या हरयस्तत्र नास्खलनापि बभ्रमुः॥ बभूवुः स्वस्थहृदयाः पद्मनालैरिवाहताः।
en: Ravana then, with flaming arrows, pierced Rāma's steeds. The celestial horses were not bewildered thereby nor their course was slackened. And they remained thoroughly unagitated as if they were stricken with lotus stalks.

sa: तस्मादाश्वासयात्मानं बलं चाश्वासय स्वकम्। यावत्सैन्यानि सर्वाणि पुनः संस्थापयाम्यहम्॥
en: Therefore do you comfort yourself, do you also cheer up your own forces, while I am engaged in composing all the troops.

sa: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शुभा॥ अगस्त्यस्याश्रमश्चैव दृश्यते कदलीवृतः।
en: Do you behold there the beautiful and sacred river Godāvarī having clear water and the hermitage of Agastya, surrounded by plantain trees.

sa: स लब्धसंज्ञो गदया वालिपुत्रमवस्थितम्। जघान परमक्रुद्धो वक्षोदेशे निशाचरः॥
en: Then the night-ranger, recovering his senses, with his mace in high rage hit at the breast Vāli's son staying in the field.

sa: सीतयाप्येवमुक्तोऽहमब्रुवं मैथिली तथा। पृष्ठमारोह मे देवि क्षिप्रं जनकनन्दिनि॥ यावत्ते दर्शयाम्यद्य ससुग्रीवं सलक्ष्मणम्। राघवं च महाभागे भरिमसितेक्षणे॥
en: And being thus accosted by Maithili, I said-Do you speedily place yourself on my back, O worshipful dame,oyou the daughter of king Janaka, and I shall soon show you, O great dame you having dark blue eyes, your lord along with Sugrīva and Lakşmaņa.'

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तमामन्त्र्य त्वमरैः सह। यथागतं ययुः सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमाः॥
en: Having thus said all the Gods followed by Pitāmaha Brahmă went to the directions they came from with the permission of Vāyu.

sa: एवमुक्तो हनुमता भरतः कैकयीसुतः। पपात सहसा हृष्टो हर्षान्मोहमुपागमत्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Hanumān, Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi, delighted, fell down all on a sudden in a swoon of joy.

sa: राक्षसानां बलं श्रेष्ठं भूयः परमशोभत। तत्रोन्मत्ता इवोत्पेतुर्हरयोऽथ युयुत्सवः॥
en: The monkeys, eager for encounter, darted forward like maniacs, and began to despatch the night-rangers with rocks and trees and clenched fist.

sa: अयोध्यां तु समालोक्य चिन्तयामास राघवः। प्रियकामः प्रियं रामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमः॥
en: Thereupon beholding Ayodhyā, Råma, the descendant of Raghu, of light movements and desirous of affording delight to others, thought of welcoming (them).

sa: रामेण हि प्रतिज्ञातं हवृक्षगणसंनिधौ। उत्सादनममित्राणां सीता यैस्तु प्रधर्षिता॥
en: Rāma has in presence of the tawny-eyed (ones) forsooth promised the annihilation of the foe by whom Sītā has been sore oppressed.

sa: संभ्रमश्च न कर्तव्यो वर्तन्त्या रावणालये। विभीषणविधेयं हि लकैचर्यमिदं कृतम्॥ तदाश्वसिहि विस्रब्धं स्वगृहे परिवर्तसे। अयं चाभ्येति संहृष्टस्त्वदर्शनसमुत्सुकः॥
en: Do you not be afraid for living in Rāvana's abode for I have placed at Vibhīşana's hands the sovereignty of Lanka. Do you be consoled thinking as if that you are living in your own house. To behold you, Vibhisana, delighted, shall soon proceed.

sa: रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्वा हरयो रामसंनिधौ। चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम्॥
en: Hearing those painful words of Răma, the monkeys desired Hanumān, conversant with the whereabouts of Sītā, to describe every thing to him.

sa: सीते पर्याप्तमेतावद् भर्तुः स्नेहः प्रदर्शितः। सर्वत्रातिकृतं भद्रे व्यसनायोपकल्पते॥
en: O Sītā, you had shown enough of attachment towards your husband. But, O gentle dame, excess of any thing tends to evil.

sa: ते तु वृक्षान्समादाय संप्रचिक्षिपुराहवे। खङ्गेन प्रतिचिक्षेप तान्प्रजङ्घो महाबलः॥
en: They, taking up trees, hurled them in the conflict (against their antagonists); and the powerful Prājantha resisted all those with his swords.

sa: पितृपैतामहं चैतत् पूर्वकैरभिरक्षितम्। न मे मधुवनं हन्याददृष्ट्वा जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: Without beholding the daughter of the king Janaka they would not have dared to destroy Madhuvana obtained and preserved by my forefathers.

sa: ततोऽन्यं देशमास्थाय शक्रः संत्यज्य रावणम्। अयुध्यत महाराज राक्षसांस्त्रासयरणे॥
en: Having said this and left aside Råvaņa, Sakra went to another side, O King, and fought terrifying the Rākşasas in the conflict.

sa: अधर्मसंश्रितो धर्मो विनाशयति राघव। सर्वमेतद्यथाकर्म काकुत्स्थ कुरुते नरः॥
en: O Rāghava, virtue aided by prowess, destroy enemies. Therefore, O Kakutstha, people, for compassing their ends, resort to both virtue and prowess.

sa: समीपस्थं बलाध्यक्षं खरपुत्रोऽब्रवीद्वचः। रथमानीयतां तूर्णं सैन्यं त्वानीयतां त्वरात्॥
en: Khara's son spoke to the commander who was near him, saying, “Do you speedily bring the chariot here and all the soldiers."

sa: ते दीनमनसः सर्वे सुश्रुवुः काननौकसः। वानरेन्द्रस्य निर्घोषं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम्॥
en: All those rangers of woods, (staying) dispirited, heard the roars of that foremost of monkeys, like to the roaring of rain-pouring clouds.

sa: प्रदृश्यमानः सर्वत्र हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥ भेजेऽम्बरं निरालम्बं पक्षयुक्त इवाद्रिराट्।
en: And everywhere Hanumān, son to the wind god coursing through the unsupported sky, looked like the monarch of mountains furnished with wings.

sa: गतासुीभवेगस्तु नैर्ऋतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः। पपा स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा॥
en: And fell down on the earth from the chariot, the highly effulgent Rāvaņa, gifted with dreadful velocity and shom of his life.

sa: तं समासाद्य वेगेन वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। तलेनाभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः कर्णमूले सकुण्डले॥
en: Approaching him vehemently, Vali's son, gifted with great prowess, in anger struck him, with clenched fist, on his ears having excellent kundalas.

sa: क्ष्वेडन्त्यन्ये नदन्त्यन्ये गर्जन्त्यन्ये महाबलाः॥ चक्रुः किलकिलामन्ये प्रतिगर्जन्ति चापरे।
en: And thereupon, some of mighty ones roared, and some shouted, and some blustered, and some raised ululations, and others stormed (in return).

sa: मेरुमन्दरसंकाशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः॥
en: And there highly powerful ones, having huge persons, resembling the Mount Mandara, covered the welkin as if like so many mad elephants.

sa: रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता। नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिभर्तरि चोत्तमा॥ यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं स महात्मा दशाननः। निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति ॥
en: And hearing of the friendship between Rāma and Sugrīva she attained to an excess of delight. She is well behaved and devoted to her lord per excellence and blessed is the high-souled and ten-necked demon that she has not destroyed him (yet). And Rama shall become an instrument only in in bringing about his destruction.

sa: प्लवगस्योरूवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः। मन्दरोऽप्यवशीर्येत किं पुनयुधि राक्षसाः॥
en: Even the mount Mandra is weakened by the velocity of the thighs of the high-souled monkey Nīla-what of the Rākşasas in conflict?

sa: वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः। तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः॥ रावणोऽयं महाबाहुरिति संचिन्त्य वानरः। सोऽयमेव पुरा शेते पुरमध्ये गृहोत्तमे। अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: That highly energetic monkey beheld that effulgent (Rāvana) surrounded by excellent damsels like to moon encircled by stars. And beholding him the monkey reflected—“This must be Rāvana-for he is the person whom I saw sleeping in an excellent apartment in that city.” Thinking this, that highly effulgent son of Maruta-Hanuman leaped (high upon another branch).

sa: तमभ्यधावशतशो नदन्तः काननौकसः। ते दुमांश्च महाकाया गिरिशृङ्गाणि चोद्यतः॥
en: Thereupon hundreds of huge-bodied monkeys, emitting cries and taking up crags and trees proceeded towards him (Indrajit) and hurled them at him.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु शक्रेण देवाः शक्रसमा युधि। संनह्य सुमहासत्त्वा युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Sakra, the celestials, his equals in the encounter and gifted with great prowess, armed themselves for fight. some

sa: तदप्रमेयप्रतिकारकृत्रिमं कृतं स्वयं साध्विति विश्वकर्मणा। दिवं गते वायुपथे प्रतिष्ठितं व्यराजतादित्यपथस्य लक्ष्म तत्॥
en: And the car, embellished with transcendentally beautiful figures, belauded by Viśvakarmā himself as constituting the acme (of his art), which, mounting the welkin, looked like a mark of the Sun's orbit, appeared resplendent.

sa: आद(भुक्षितो मांसं शोणितं तृषितोऽपिबत्। मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यांश्च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा॥
en: And hungering, he fed on flesh and athirst, drank blood. And then that enemy of Sakra drank vesselfuls of fat and blood.

sa: हत्वा पञ्चशतान् योधाञ्छरैराशिविषोपमैः॥ प्रायात् स शनकैर्वीरो धनंजयरथं प्रति।
en: Slaying five hundred warriors with his arrows resembling snakes of virulent poison, the heroic Satyaki proceeded slowly towards the car of Dhananjaya.

sa: अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भास्वरं वेगवत्तरम्। तत्राधाय शरं तीक्ष्णं परानीकविशातनम्॥
en: Took up another bow, resplendent and capable of bearing great strain. Placing on its string a sharp arrow fatal to the foe.

sa: हतो जयद्रथश्चैव सौमदत्तिश्च वीर्यवान्। अभीषाहा शूरसेनाः शिबयोऽथ वसातयः॥
en: King Jayadratha, that powerful monarch, the son of Somadatta, the Ameeshahas, the Surasenas, the Curas and the Vysatis have (all) been slain.

sa: तौ शूरौ समरे राजन् परस्परकृतागसौ। परस्परमुदीक्षेतां क्रोधादुद्दृत्य चक्षुषी॥
en: In the field of battle, O monarch, those two heroic warriors committed injuries to each other. They also looked upon each other.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच न व्यथाभ्यधिका काचिद् विद्यतेमम संजय। दिष्टमेतत् पुरा मन्ये कथयस्व यथेच्छकम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, no great anguish does find place in me. For, I think that all this is (the unavoidable consequence of) superior destiny. So, do you describe according as you desire.

sa: ततो द्रोण: केकयांश्च धृष्टद्युम्नस्य चात्मजान्। सम्प्रेषयत् प्रेतलोकं सर्वानिषुभिराशुगैः॥
en: But Drona, by means of his swift-going darts, sent the Kekayas and sons of Dhrishtadyumna to the region of the departed spirits.

sa: श्रुतायुरपि चाम्बष्ठः क्षत्रियाणां धुरंधरः। चरन्नभीतवत् संख्ये निहतः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Fearlessly roving about in the field of battle, the Ambastha chief Shrutayus, the most exalted of the Kshatriyas, was slain by Savyasachin.

sa: य वार्यमाणो भीमेन शितैर्बाणैः समन्ततः। सूतपुत्रो महाराज भीमसेनमवैक्षत॥
en: Opposed on all sides by sharp arrows shot by Bhimasena, that son of Suta, O mighty : monarch, began to eye Bhima.

sa: तेन वृष्णिप्रवीराणां चक्रं न प्रतिहन्यते। अपि मेरुं वहेत् कश्चित् तरेद् वा मकरालयम्।
en: For this it is that prowess of the Vrishni heroes are never thwarted. It is possible for one to carry on his shoulders the Meru mountain or the swim across the very ocean.

sa: क्रोधितस्यु रणे पार्थो नाराचं कालसम्मितम्। द्रोणपुत्राय चिक्षेप कालदण्डमिवापरम्॥
en: with anger Filled with anger Partha discharged in that battle at Drona's son a Naracha like unto the very rod of Death.

sa: मद्रराजो महाराज विराटं वाहिनीपतिम्। आजने त्वरितस्तूर्णं शतेन नतपर्वणाम्॥
en: The king of Madra, O great monarch, displaying great alacrity, quickly wounded Virata, the chief of a great force, with straight arrows.

sa: तथा हयसहस्रैश्च नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरत्। ते महास्त्राणि सर्वाणि विकिरन्तोऽर्जुनं प्रति॥
en: And an equal number of horses, began furiously to assault him. His troops then began to discharge many celestial weapons against Arjuna.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ विराटं दशभिः शरैः। आजघ्नतुः सुसंक्रुद्धौ तव पुत्रहितैषिणौ॥
en: Then the two Avanti princes Vinda and Anuvinda, those well-wishers of your son, inflamed with rage, pierced Virata with ten sharp arrows.

sa: अन्योन्यं समुपाश्रित्य न त्यक्ष्यन्ति रणाजिरम्। एतदन्तमासाद्य चोदयाश्वान् प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: Penetrating into these divisions, do you cheerfully urge the steeds on. O charioteer, carry me in a medium speed to the spot.

sa: विद्रावयंस्तव चमूं शतशो व्यधमच्छरैः। अनिलेन यथाभ्राणि विच्छिन्नानि समन्ततः॥
en: Began to crush your troops by hundreds and thousands. Just as masses of clouds are torn as under by a violent storm.

sa: सम्भ्रान्ताः पर्यधावन्त तस्मिस्तमसि दारुणे। विजित्य समरे योधांस्तावकान् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: They then fled away in great fright in that darkness of night. O foremost of the Bharatas, defeating your troops in battle.

sa: सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैसिभिरेव त्रिवेणुकम्। धनुरेकेन चिच्छेद चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्॥
en: (And) with three darts he cut-off his charioteer, with three more his Trivenu, with one his bow and with four his horses.

sa: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैः कर्ण आकर्णनिःसृतः। जघान पाण्डबलं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then Karna, drawing the bow-strings close to his ears, shot numberless sharp shafts, which destroyed the Pandava forces by hundreds and thousands.

sa: तावन्योन्यं शरैः संख्ये संछाद्य सुमहारथैः। पुनः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैर्विव्यधाते परस्परम्॥
en: In that dreadful battle, they both covering each other with their arrowy showers, pierced each other with shafts shot from fully-stretched bows.

sa: आचार्यो हि सुसंयत्तो भृशं यत्ताश्च पाण्डवाः। तं रक्षत सुसंयत्ता निघ्नतं शात्रवान् रणे॥
en: The preceptor is of benevolent disposition and the Pandavas are trying their utmost (to slay him). United together you will protect him while he will be engaged in destroying his enemies in battle.

sa: तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं पाञ्चाल्यः शत्रुकर्शनः॥ अन्यदादत्त वेगेन धनुर्भारसहं नवम्।
en: Throwing away that broken bow, that oppressor of foes, the prince of Panchala, quickly took up a new and more elastic one.

sa: अब्रवीच तदा कृष्णमयमस्यनुशाधि माम्॥ ततस्तं मेघसंकाशं दीप्तास्यं दीप्तकुण्डलम्। अभ्यभाषत हैडिम्बि दाशार्हः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: He proudly said-"Here am I order me.” Thereupon the descendant of the Dasarha race Krishna, addressing Hidimva's son of the complexion of clouds, of effulgent countenance and fiery eyes smilingly said these words.

sa: एष कर्णो महेष्वासो मतिमान् दृढविक्रमः। पाण्डवानामनीकेषु निहन्ति क्षत्रियर्षभान्॥
en: Yonder does the mighty bowman Karna of great intelligence and resolute prowess, burn the foremost of the Kshatriyas of the Pandava host.

sa: तमेकं रथवंशेन महता पर्यवारयन्। विकर्षन्तश्च चापानि विसृजन्तश्च सायकान्॥
en: Then with a mighty host of cars, they surrounded that single-handed hero, stretching their bows and discharging their arrows right and left.

sa: परिवयुस्ततः शूरा गजीनीकेन सर्वतः। किरन्तो विधिधास्तीक्ष्णान् सायकान् लघुवेधिनः॥
en: The brave Kaurava warriors surrounded him with their elephant division, shooting sharp arrows of various kinds, all capable of penetrating through everything.

sa: शृणु राजन्निहोत्पतिं शैनेयस्य यथा पुरा। यथा च भूरिश्रवसो यत्र ते संशयो नृप॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear, O monarch, how the grandson of Sini came to being in days gone by as also how Bhurisravas was descended. O ruler of men, this will explain all your doubts.

sa: तं तथाद्भुतकर्माणं शरसम्पातवर्षिणम्। न केचनाभ्यधावन् वै सात्यकि सैनिकाः॥
en: None of your troops then ventured to encounter Satyaki who was achieving many feats with extreme lightness and showering torrents of arrows.

sa: अलायुधस्य तु शिरो भैमसेनिर्महाबलः। दुर्योधनस्य प्रमुखे चिक्षेप गतचेतसः॥
en: Then the highly puissant son of Bhima threw that head of Alayudha at he face of Duryodhana who was then rendered insensible.

sa: वचनं मम धर्मज्ञ भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भवामि ते॥ न तेऽर्जुनस्तथा ज्ञेयो ज्ञातव्यः सात्यकिर्यथा।
en: O my most dutiful brother, carry out my behests as I am your elder brother. Think that Satyaki is dearer to you than your brother Arjuna (so try to help Satyaki the more).

sa: ब्रूहि कृष्ण यथातत्त्वं त्वं हि प्राज्ञतमः सदा। भवन्नेत्रा रणे शत्रून् विजेष्यन्तीह पाण्डवाः॥
en: Speak, O Krishna, truly on this point? You are ever the foremost of the wise. The sons of Pandu, having yourself only for their eyes, can hope to vanquish their enemies in battle.

sa: अन्योन्यं क्षोभयामासुः सैन्यानि नृपसत्तम। वध्यमानानि सैन्यानि समन्तात् तैर्महारथैः॥
en: Began, O best of the Bharatas, to afflict each other and the troops. The soldiers, (thus) terribly slaughtered by those great car-warriors.

sa: दीर्यते चमहत् सैन्यं सृञ्जयानां महारणे॥ हस्तिकक्षो ह्यसौ कृष्ण केतुः कर्णस्य धीमतः। दृश्यते राजसैन्यस्य मध्ये विचरतो मुदा॥
en: And even the vast force of the Srinjayas appears to give way in this great battle. There in the midst of Yudhishthira's division, the banner, of the highly intelligent Karna, bearing the device of an elephant is seen to move about with great activity.

sa: त्वत्सहायो ह्यहं कृष्ण त्रील्लोकान् वै समागतान्। प्रापयेयं परं लोकं किमु कर्णं महाहवे॥
en: O Krishna, with you at my elbow, bidding defiance to all the three worlds, marshalled in array, I can well launch them (on and all), into eternity, what speak you of Karna then.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं शरेणानतपर्वणा। विव्याध समरे तूर्णं प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Then having cut-off his bow, he pierced that foremost wielder of the bow quickly in that battle with shafts of depressed knots.

sa: तेनाहमिषुणा शल्य वासुदेवधनंजयौ। योत्स्ये परमसंक्रुद्धस्तत् कर्म सदृशं मम॥
en: Worked up with anger, I shall with that arrow, O Shalya, fight Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. That will be a deed becoming me.

sa: शिवाश्च वैश्वानरदीप्तजिह्वाः सुभीमनादाः शतशा नदन्तीः। रक्षोगणान् नर्दतश्चापि वीक्ष्य नरेन्द्र योधा व्यथिता बभूवुः॥
en: Jackals having tongues like the leaping flames of fire began to utter fierce howls by hundreds; the Rakshasa also uttered fierce yells. Hearing these disagreeable sounds, O king, your troops were greatly afflicted.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय बृहत्क्षत्रो हसन्निव। व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे क्षेमधूति महारथम्॥
en: After this Brihatkshatra smilingly taking up another bow deprived the mighty car-warrior Kshemadhurti of the use of his car, steed and charioteer.

sa: एतद् रक्षः स्वेन कायेण तूर्णं मतिप्रमाणेन विवर्धता च। रक्षौहिणीं तव तूर्णं जघान॥
en: Then falling down with force, the Rakshasa, with his huge and still increasing body, desirous of benefiting the Pandavas, slew a full Akshauhini of your troops, while he himself gave up his life.

sa: असम्भ्रान्तश्च समरे सात्यकिः कुरुपुङ्गवम्। छादयामास बाणौधैः समन्ताद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: 0 best of the Bharatas, the dauntless Satyaki also completely covered that most exalted the Kurus with arrowy showers in that battle.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु निर्विद्धो द्रोणेन भरतर्षभ। उत्ससर्ज धनुस्तूर्णं संदश्य दशनच्छदम्॥
en: Pierced sore by Drona, Dhristadyumna, O foremost of the Bharatas, threw quickly aside the (severed) bow and bit his lips (in anger).

sa: स शोभमानो वरदः खगी बाणी शरासनी॥ प्रदीपयन् रथे तस्थौ त्रील्लोकान् स्वेन तेजसा।
en: That handsome personage, that giver of boons, that holder of the sword, arrow and bow rested upon that car and looked most resplendent with his own energy shedding lustre upon the three worlds.

sa: यदि हि स निहतः शयीत भूमौ यदुकुलपाण्डवनन्दनो महात्मा। ननु तव वसुधा नरेन्द्र सर्वा सगिरिसमुद्रवना वशं व्रजेत॥
en: If that illustrious delighter, of the Yadu race and of the Pandavas, had lain prostrate on the field being slain in battle then, O ruler of men, this earth certainly would have fallen under your sway together with all her mountains, forests and seas.

sa: तत्राद्भुतपपश्याम पञ्चालानां पराक्रमम्॥ वध्यमानापि यत् कर्ण नाजहू रणमूर्धनि।
en: The Panchalas also showed very great courage, for they never left the head of the battle-field, even when thus distressed by Karna.

sa: तं भीमसेनो नामृष्यदवमानममर्षणः। स तस्मै व्यसृजत् तूर्ण शरवर्षममित्रहा॥
en: Bhima excited with wrath, did not bear that insult; and that slayer of foes quickly sped a shower of shafts at Karna.

sa: तस्यायसं वर्म वरं वररत्नविभूषितम्। ताराव्याप्तस्य नभसः शारदस्य समत्विषम्॥
en: His best armour, made of iron and bedecked with the most precious gems, shone like the autumnal firmament besprinkled with innumerable stars.

sa: तस्य हस्तस्थिता शक्तिः कालरात्रिरिवोद्यता। दैवोपहतबुद्धित्वान्न तां कर्णो विमुक्तवान्॥ कृष्णे वा देवकीपुत्रे मोहितो देवमायया। पार्थे वा शक्रकल्पे वै वधार्थं वासवीं प्रभो॥
en: Indeed because his intelligence had been confounded by destiny itself that he did not, stupefied by the illusion of the Gods, hur) that death dealing lart given him by Vasava, though he held in his hand, at Krishna the son of Devaki it at Parthas of prowess equal to that of Indra, for their destruction.

sa: तेजसा वह्निसदृशो वायुवेगसमो जवे। अन्तकप्रतिमः क्रोधे सिंहसंहननो बली॥
en: He is valarous like Agni, swift like the speed of the wind, furious like the Destroyer, strong and powerful like the lion.

sa: असौ कृष्ण महेष्वासः काम्यके मामुपस्थितः। उषितश्च सहास्माभिर्यावन्नासीद् धनंजयः॥
en: O Krishna, this fierce bowman went to see me in the Kamyaka forest. he there lived with us until Dhananjaya came back.

sa: बहूनि सुनृशंसानि कृतान्येतेन मानद। युष्मासु पापमतिना अपापेष्वेव नित्यदा॥
en: O bestower of honour, sinless though you all are, this one of sinful understanding had always injured you with many cruel wrongs.

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनेनैवमुक्तो द्रौणिराहवदुर्मदः। चकारारिवधे यत्नमिन्द्रो दैत्यवधे यथा॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus addressed by Duryodhana, the son of Drona invincible in battle, tried to destroy the enemies like Indra the Daytas.

sa: तदिदं तव कार्यं तु दूरप्राप्तं विजानता। न कृतं यत् त्वया पूर्व प्राप्ताप्राप्तविचारणम्॥
en: That act of yours has been far from bringing out the desired end. Although you are possessed of knowledge, yet you did not consider before hand the propreity and impropriety of you actions.

sa: विव्याध च रणे राजन् सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमभू॥ दशभिर्विशिस्तीक्ष्णैरभिक्रुद्धः स्तनान्तरे।
en: Then again inflamed with rage, he pierced, O king, Satyaki of indomitable prowess on the chest, with ten shafts of great sharpness.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव राजेन्द्र समाहत्य परस्परम्। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां वीरावाश्वासतां पुनः॥
en: Then, O foremost of men, striking each other, they took respite only for a moment before the presence of all the troop.

sa: ततो मुहूर्ताद भुवनं ज्योतिर्भूतमिवाभवत्। अप्रख्यमप्रकाशं च जगामाशु तमस्तथा॥
en: Then within a moment the world was flooded with a stream of light and the palpable cnvelop of gloom soon fled away.

sa: योग्यो राजा भीमसेनो महात्मा कीबस्य वा मम किं राज्यकृत्यम्। न चापि शक्तः परुषाणि सोढुं पुनस्तवेमानि रुषान्वितस्य॥
en: A sinner that I am, I would repair to the woods this very day, relived of my company may you live in happiness. The magnanimous Bhimasena is worthy of the throne. An impotent that I am, what the use of my having the sovereignty?

sa: शूराः शूरैः समागम्य शरतोमरशक्तिभिः। विव्यधुः समरेऽन्योन्यं निन्युश्चैव यमक्षयम्॥
en: Heroes encounter (rival) heroes smote one another with arrows, lances and darts and quickly sent one another of the region of Yama.

sa: अस्मिश्चेदागते काले श्रेयो न प्रतिपत्स्यसे। असम्भावितरूपस्त्वं सुनृशंसं करिष्यसि।॥
en: If at this opportune season you do not exert yourself to attain good, then you shall act meanly like a perfect wreath.

sa: तेऽन्योन्यं समरे योधाः शरशक्तिपरश्वधैः। प्रेषयन् परलोकाय विचरन्तो ह्यभीतवत्॥
en: The warrior moving about fearlessly on the field of battle sent one another to the next world by arrows, darts and battle-axes.

sa: आस्यानन्तरतस्त्वेतद् दाक्षिणात्यं महद् बलम्। तदनन्तरमेतच बाह्निकानां महद् बलम्॥
en: Beyond this latter array is the division of the Valhikas, beyond which again stand the division of Karna, firmly resolved to fight.

sa: एवं मारिष संग्रामो नरवाजिगजक्षयः। कुरूणां सृञ्जयानां च देवासुरसमोऽभवत्॥
en: Thus, O father, the battle, putting the Kurus and Srinjayas resembled that between the gods and demons in the days of yore.

sa: भीषणं सुमहाराज सिंहनादविराजितम्। ततस्ते पाण्डवा राजन् पञ्चालाश्च यशस्विनः॥
en: Was hot and furious and ruining with thundering shouts, O great monarch. Then, O king, the Pandavas and and the renowned Panchalas.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमहत्वाहं न विमोक्ष्यामि दंशनम्। अनृतायां प्रतिज्ञायां नाहं स्वर्गमवाप्नुयाम्॥
en: Without slaying Dhristadyumna, I will not lay aside my arms. If this my promise proves futile, I will not go to heaven.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच राम तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते विदितं मे तवेप्सितम्। कुरुष्व पूतमात्मानं सर्वमेतदवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Mahadeva said O Rama, are you happy? I am exceedingly satisfied with you; and what you desire is known to me. Do you make your soul sanctified. You will obtain all your desire.

sa: स्पर्धिनश्च महेष्वासाः कृतयला धनुर्धराः। अभ्यगच्छंस्तथान्योन्यं मत्ता गजवृषा इव॥
en: All proud and mighty bowmen, putting forth their greatest effort, rushed upon one another, like infuriate leaders of the herds of elephants.

sa: बहूनेकरथेनाजौ योधयित्वा महारथान्। आचार्यप्रमुखान् पार्थ प्रयात्येष स सात्यकिः॥
en: Having encountered on a single car many mighty car-warriors having Drona at their head, the heroic Satyaki is approaching you, O Arjuna.

sa: तां च सेनामतिक्रम्य कलिङ्गानां दुरत्ययाम्। अथ पार्थ महाबाहुर्धनंजयमुपासदत्॥
en: Passing through the division of the Kalingas that was incapable being passed through, the mighty-armed Satyaki approached Dhananjaya the son of Pritha.

sa: युयुधानोऽपि राजेन्द्र भोजानीकाद् विनिःसृतः॥ प्रययौ त्वरितस्तूर्ण काम्बोजानां महाचमूम्।
en: O mighty monarch, Yuyudhana also cmerging out of the division of the Bhojas, quickly proceeded against the strong host of the Kambojas.

sa: पराक्रमां तयोर्योधा ददृशुस्ते सुविस्मिताः। तयोः समभवद् युद्धं द्रोणपाण्डवयोर्महत्॥
en: Then seeing their prowess, the warriors were filled with delight. Thereafter a mighty battle raged between Drona and that son of Pandu.

sa: रिपून् भार्गव देवानां जहि सर्वान् समागतान्। लोकानां हितकामार्थं मत्प्रीत्यर्थं तथैव च ॥
en: O descendant of Bhrigu race, do you slaughter all the antagonists of the celestials, who have assembled here, out of desire for benefiting all the worlds, as also for the satisfaction of myself.

sa: किमाश्चर्यं पुनमूर्दो धर्मकामो ह्यपण्डितः। सुमहत् प्राप्नुयात् पापमापगास्विव कौशिकः॥
en: What wonder then that an ignorant and inexperienced person, intending to practise virtue, would commit grave vice like Kaushika on the river-bank."

sa: सम्प्रहारमकुर्वस्ते सर्वे च सुमहारथाः। अमर्षिताः सत्त्ववन्तः कृत्वा मरणमग्रतः॥
en: Then all those mighty car-warriors, possessed of strength and inspired with wraih. fell to smite one another, keeping death in their view.

sa: निवारितास्तु ते वीरास्तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। समसज्जन्त चत्वारो वाताः पर्वतयोरिव॥
en: Resisted by those two foremost of men, those four brave warriors encountered the former like the winds assailing a pair of mountains.

sa: तत्रेषुभिः क्षिष्यमाणैः पतद्भिश्च शरीरिषु। अग्नेरिव महाकक्षे शब्दः समभवन्महान्॥ तयोः शरसहस्रश्च संछन्नं वसुधातलम्।
en: Loud clashing sounds there, resembling that produced by a raging conflagration consuming a large forest. The surface of the earth was then covered with those thousands of shafts shot by both of them.

sa: अतिष्ठद् रथमार्गेषु सैन्धवं प्रतिपालयन्। अथैनं कौरवश्रेष्ठाः सर्व एव महारथाः॥ महता रथवंशेन सर्वतः प्रत्यवारयन्। विस्फारयन्तश्चापानि विसृजन्तश्च सायकान्॥
en: Impeded the progress of Arjuna's chariot, with a view to protect the ruler of the Sindhus. Then many foremost one among the Kurus all great car-warriors, surrounded Arjuna on all sides with a large number of chariots, stretching their bows and discharging numerous arrows.

sa: अथान्यदादाय धनुः स शीघ्र कर्णात्मजः पाण्डवमभ्यविध्यत्। दिव्यैरस्त्रैरभ्यवर्षच सोऽपि कर्णस्य पुत्रो नकुलं कृतास्त्रः॥
en: Karna's son promptly took up another bow and distressed the son of Pandu with many powerful and celestial weapons. Vrishasena master of many powerful weapons, began to pour down celestial weapons upon Nakula.

sa: अस्मान् नैवं पुत्रदारैर्विहीनान् सुखाद्धृष्टान् राज्यनाशाच भूयः॥ द्रष्टा लोकः पतिनानप्यगाधे पापैर्जुष्टे नरके पाण्डवेय।
en: The world will not then seen us bereft of family and children, deprived of our happiness and kingdom and sunk, O son of Pandu, into the fathomless abyss of the hell of torment.

sa: सपताकाध्वजा: पेतुर्विशीर्णा इव पर्वताः। पत्तिभिश्च समाप्लुत्य द्विरदाः स्यन्दनास्तथा॥
en: The elephants and cars being smitten down by the foot-soldiers, their standards along with their banner fell down like the cloven mountains.

sa: वध्यमानेषु संग्रामे पञ्चालेषु महात्मना। उदीर्यमाणे द्रोणारे पाण्डवान् भयमाविशत्॥
en: Then beholding the slaughter of the Panchalas by the high-souled Drona and seeing his weapons enshroud all sides, the Pandavas became frightened.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता महेष्वासेन धन्विना। ईषन्मूर्छा जगामाशु सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki of invincible prowess, being thus deeply pierced by that mighty and fierce bowman, was soon partially deprived of his senses.

sa: अभ्यवर्तत कर्णस्तदितोऽपि शरैर्भृशम्। तावन्योन्यं समासाद्य वृषभौ सर्वधन्विनाम्॥ विसृजन्तौ शरान् दीप्तान् व्यभ्राजेता मनस्विनौ।
en: Though greatly assailed by Satyaki Karna still approached Bhima; approaching each : other, those two best of archers, the two highly energetic heroes, appeared highly resplendent as they discharged arrows at each other.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजन् स्वर्णपुखञ्छिलीमुखान्। दुर्योधन चिक्षेप त्रयोदश शिलाशितान्॥
en: Thereupon king Yudhishthira shot at Duryodhana thirteen keen arrows, that were furnished with the wings made of gold, sharpened on a stone.

sa: सर्वेषामेव पार्थानां फाल्गुनो बलवत्तरः। तस्यामोघां विमोक्ष्यामि शक्तिं शक्रविनिर्मिताम्॥
en: Among all the sons of Pritha. Phalguna is the most powerful. I will hurl at him the unfailing dart made by Shakra.

sa: तौ धरामन्वपद्येतो वातरुग्णाविव दुमौ॥ विकटश्च सहयोभौ देवपुत्रोपमौ नृप।
en: Then Vikata and Saha, looking like two celestial youths, fell down on earth like a couple of trees uprooted by a tempest.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः सहसा किरीटी भ्रात्रा समत्रं नकुलेन संख्ये। कपिध्वजं केशवसंगृहीतं प्रैषीदुदग्रो वृषसेम्य वाहम्॥
en: The fierce warrior Dhananjaya, whose head was adorned with diadem, on hearing these words, riding up to Vrikodara's car, drove straight on his great ape-bannered car with Keshava as its drive towards Vrishasena.

sa: मनुष्याश्वगजानां च शरीरैर्गतजीवितैः। क्षणेन भूमिः संजज्ञे संवृता भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, the field became soon covered over with the corpses and carcarsses of slain men, horses and elephants.

sa: सादिभिश्च हतैः शूरैः संकीर्णा वसुधाभवत्। बाणपातनिकृत्तास्तु योधास्ते कुरुसत्तम॥
en: And with heroic horsemen lying slain, the earth became impassable. O foremost of the Kurus, the warriors lacerated with the falling shafts.

sa: उपस्थितमिदं घोरं युद्धं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् यजनाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावद् भूमिर्धरिष्यति॥
en: You will soon witness the fight that will bewilder the three worlds and it will be spoken of till the world ends.

sa: भोजानीकेन शिष्टेन कलिङ्गारट्टबाह्निकैः। कृतवर्मा वृतो राजन् प्रायात् सुजवनैर्हयैः॥
en: Kritavarman, surrounded by the Bhoja division and the remnants of the Kalingas, Asratta and Valhikas, fled away borne by his swift steeds.

sa: शिखण्डी तु समासाद्य हृदिकानां महारथम्॥ पञ्चभिर्निशितैर्भल्लै त्रुदेशे समाहनत्।
en: Shikhandin, however, coming against the mightiest car-warrior of the Hridika race struck him with five sharp and broad-headed arrows at the shoulder-joint.

sa: विव्याध चैन दशभिः क्रुद्धो नृत्यन्निवेषुभिः। कर्णं च तूर्णं विव्याधि त्रिसप्तत्या शितैः शरै॥
en: Worked up with anger and as if dancing on his car he quickly bored through Sushena with ten arrows and pierced Karna himself with seventy sharp arrows within the twinkling of an eye.

sa: भीरुवित्रासकारिण्यः शूराणां हर्षवर्धनाः। ता नद्यो घोररूपास्तु नयन्त्यो यमसादनम्॥
en: They struck terror unto the timid and increased the joy of the brave. Those awful rivers led to the abode of Yama.

sa: घटोत्कचस्य तामाज्ञां प्रतिगृह्याथ राक्षसाः। दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वला महावक्त्रा घोररूपा भयानकाः॥
en: In obedience to that order of Ghatotkacha, the Rakshasas, possessed of blazing teeth, large faces and terrible features, capable of causing dread.

sa: संजय उवाच छद्मना निहतं श्रुत्वा पितरं पापकर्मणा। बाष्पेणापूर्यत द्रौणी रोषेण च नरर्षभ।।।।
en: Sanjaya said Hearing that his father has been slain by underhand means by Dhristadyumna of sinful deeds, Drona's son became filled, O foremost of men, with tears as well as with (extreme) rage.

sa: शङ्खवर्णाश्च तानश्वान् बाणैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। सारथिं च तथाप्यस्य रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: The former then felled the latter's charioteer from his niche on the car. Thereupon Vikartana's son was preyed upon by anxious thoughts.

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महाराज पाण्डवैर्जितकाशिभिः। धार्तराष्ट्रबलं दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतं वै समन्ततः॥
en: Beholding the army of Duryodhana, thus routed on all sides, the Pandavas, filled with the desire of victory, sent up loud war-cries.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ तथा शूरौ येन जित्वा महारणे॥ कमप्यर्थं पुरस्कृत्य न हतौ युधि मारिष।
en: So also, O sire, the two war-like sons of Madri, having been first vanquished by him in that dreadful battle, were not slain by him in the field having some motive in view.

sa: तं कथं पाण्डवा युद्धे विजेष्यन्ति महारथम्॥ यो हन्यात् समरे क्रुद्धो वज्रहस्तं पुरंदरम्।
en: How will it be possible then that the Pandavas will defeat that great car-warrior in the field of battle, who, when enraged, can slaughter even Purandara, that wielder of the thunderbolt, in battle.

sa: एष मद्रेश्वरो राजा रथाने पर्यवस्थितः॥ नियच्छति हयान्सय राधेयस्यामितौजसः।
en: The king of Madra (Shalya) is seated on the front of the car and guiding the horses of the powerful Radha's son.

sa: निपतेयुः सपत्नेषु विक्रमत्स्वपि भारत। यथेष्टमश्मवर्षेण प्रवर्षिष्ये रणे स्थितः॥
en: Will fall upon my foes contending vigorously in battle. Staying in battle I shall shower weapons as it lists men to do.

sa: कुरूनापततो दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नस्य रक्षणे। कोमन्त्रः पाण्डवेष्वासीत् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, what consultation then the Pandavas held for protecting Dhristadyumna, as they saw the Kurus return to the charge.

sa: अभिजानीहि भीमस्य सिंहनादं सुदुःसहम्॥ नदतोऽर्जुनं संग्रामे वीरस्य जितकाशिनः।
en: Do you not recognise the leonine shouts of Bhima, O Arjuna, who, worked up with the desire of achieving victory, is roaring.

sa: यस्माद् युध्यन्तमाचार्य धर्मकञ्चुकमास्थितः। मुञ्च शस्रमिति प्राह कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: "Inasmuch as Kunti's son Yudhishthira, disguised in the garb of righteousness, has spoken to the fighting Preceptor, saying 'lay you weapons aside.'

sa: तथा सत्यधृतिर्वीरो मदिराश्वश्च वीर्यवान्। सूर्यदत्तश्च विक्रान्तो निहतो द्रोणसायकैः॥
en: So also, Satyadhriti the chief of the Matshyas and powerful Madirashva and Suryadatta of mighty prowess, slaughtered by the shafts of Drona.

sa: शकुनिः पाण्डुपुत्राभ्यां कृतः सविमुखः शरैः। न स्म जानाति कर्तव्यं युद्धे किंचित् पराक्रमम्॥
en: Shakuni was then compelled to turn his face away from the field, by the arrows shot by the sons of Pandu; and unable to fight any longer, he knew not what to do.

sa: तस्य रूपमभूद् राजन् भीमसेनस्य संयुगे। खद्योतैरावृतस्येव पर्वतस्य दिनक्षये॥
en: Then O king, the appearance of Bhimasena became like that of a mountain surrounded by the fire-flies at the close of day.

sa: ततस्तद् द्रोणपुत्रस्य तेजोऽस्रबलसम्भवम्। विगाह्य तौ सुबलिनौ माययाऽऽविशतां तथा॥
en: Those two puissant persons then plunging into the energy born of the might of Ashvatthaman's weapon, betook to their power of illusion.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां श्वेतचाश्वः कृष्णसारथिः॥ ऐन्द्रमस्त्रममेयात्मा प्रादुश्चक्ते त्वरान्वितः।
en: Then regaining his consciousness the highly energetic Arjuna of white steeds and with Krishna for his charioteer, quickly discharged the Aindra weapon.

sa: यो मामद्य महात्मानं दर्शयेच्छवेतवाहनम्। तस्मै दद्यामभिप्रेतं धनं यन्मनसेच्छति॥
en: I shall give him whatever riches he will want who will point out to me today the highsouled (Arjuna) of white horses.

sa: तथैव पार्षतो राजन् द्रौणिमाहवशोभिनम्॥ शरैः संछादयामास सूतपुत्रस्य पश्यतः।
en: Before the very eyes of the charioteer's son, O king, Parshata covered Drona's son, the ornament of the battle field, with arrows.

sa: न विव्यथे महाराज तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। ततो भीमो महाबाहुः कार्तस्वरविभूषितान्॥ नाराचान् दश सम्प्रैषीद् यमदण्डनिभाञ्छितान्। ते जत्रुदेशमासाद्य द्रोणपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: O Mighty monarch, Bhima was not at all pained; and that looked indeed wonderful. Then the mighty-arined Bhima discharged ten gold-decked of great keenness resembling the darts of Death himself, at his adversary. Those shafts, O sire, falling upon the shoulder of Drona's son.

sa: कथं च युध्यमानानामपक्रान्तो महात्मनाम्। एको बहूनां शैनेयस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: The Gods and the Charanas that then came there said, "this muster will be the last of its kind on the earth."

sa: ततोऽहमस्त्रमातिष्ठं परमं तिग्मतैजसम्। दयितं देवराजस्य माधवं नाम भारत॥
en: O Bharata, I then, took up that favourite weapon of the lord of the gods, named, Madhava, possessed of exceedingly fiery energy.

sa: ततः सम्पीडयमानास्ते क्रोधाविष्टा महारथाः। अपीडयन् मां सहिताः शरशूलासिवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Then those mighty demons sore pressed by me and fired with anger, afflicted me with simultaneous discharge of clubs, darts and swords.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा बाष्यविह्वलमब्रवीत्॥ हतो दुर्योधनो राजा एकवीरो महाबलः। यस्यार्थे वैरमस्माभिरासक्तं पाण्डवैः सह॥ एकाकी बहुभिः क्षुदैराहवे शुद्धविक्रमः। पातितो भीमसेनेन एकादशचमूपतिः॥
en: Having reflected for short time Ashvatthaman said with tearful eyes,-King Duryodhana, they only hero of great might, for whose sake we were fighting with the Pandavas, has been killed. Deserted and alone through he was, the master of eleven Akshauhinis of soldiers that hero of unsullied prowess has been struck down by Bhimasena in battle.

sa: अथापश्यद्दशग्रीवो रौक्मं शरवणं महत्। गभस्तिजालसंवीतं द्वितीयमिव भास्करम्॥ स पर्वतं समारुह्य कंचिद्रम्यवनान्तरम्। प्रेक्षते पुष्पकं तत्र रामविष्टम्भितं तदा॥
en: The Ten-necked Rāvana saw the great golden wood of reeds. Furnished with networks of solar rays, and appearing like a second Sun, and ascending the mountain, he was surveying the heart of the forest, when, O Rama, Puspaka was (suddenly) deprived of its motion.

sa: मार्गान् बहुविधांस्तत्र विचेरुर्वातरंहसः। सुसंयता मातलिना प्रामनन्त दितेः सुतान्॥
en: Careered through several courses with the spread of the wind and being dexterously guided by Matali, trampled upon the sons of Diti.

sa: शिक्षाप्रमादश्च बलं धृतिश्च द्रोणे महास्त्राणि च संनतिश्च। स चेदगान्मृत्युवशं महात्मा सर्वानन्यानातुरानद्य मन्ये॥
en: In Drona were skill, practice, strength, patience, the greatest of weapons and policy. While that high-souled one has come by death I think all others, shorn of strength, on the point of death.

sa: तांस्तथा भज्यमानांस्तु कौरवान् भरतर्षभ॥ शिनेर्नप्ता किरन् बाणैरभ्यवर्तत सात्यकिः।
en: Then Shini's grandson Satyaki, O foremost of Bharatas, shooting his arrows, proceeded against the frightened Kauravas in the course of their fight.

sa: यदर्थमयमारम्भस्तत्कार्यमवसादितम्। मया हि दहता लङ्कां न सीता परिरक्षिता॥
en: I have defeated the great object for which I have laboured so much. In burning down Lankā, I have not saved Sītā.

sa: यदुक्तवान् महाप्राज्ञः क्षत्ता हितमनामयम्। तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं वचनं दिव्यदर्शिनः॥
en: Salutary and whole some, that the wonderfully wise Kshatriya had said. Those words of that true speaking one has now been realised,

sa: तथैव च वधार्थाय पुत्राणां पाण्डवो बली। नूनं जातो महाबाहुर्यथा हन्ति स्म कौरवान्॥
en: From the in thich that hero (Bhima) of longaiiii, . . .....nungine Kauravas, it may be asserted that mighty son of Pandu has surely taken his birth for the destruction of your sons.

sa: तामापतन्ती महती मृत्युपाशोपमां गदाम्। अन्तरिक्षगती रामश्चिच्छेद बहुधा शरैः॥
en: And Rāma severed in many fragments that mighty mace, resembling the noose of Death, as ascending the welkin, it was coming down.

sa: ताभ्यां मुक्ता महावेगाः शराः काञ्चनभूषणाः। दिवाकरपथं प्राप्य च्छादयामासुरम्बरम्॥
en: Shot by them both, swift-fiying arrows decked with gold, intercepting the rays of the orb of the day, (literally) covered the sky.

sa: सौतिरुवाच स्पृष्टमात्रा तु पद्भ्यां सा गरुडेन बलीयसा। अभज्यत तरोः शाखां भग्नां चैकामधारयत्॥
en: Sauti said: The moment the branch of the tree was touched by the greatly powerful Garuda with his feet, it broke down. As it was about to fall, it was caught by him.

sa: दर्शनादर्शनेनैव सोऽपाकर्षत राघवम्। स दूरमाश्रमस्यास्य मारीचो मृगतां गतः॥
en: And Mārica wearing the shape of a deer, showing himself and disappearing from sight, drew Rāghava a long way from the hermitage.

sa: शक्रं याश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणं याश्च भामिनीः। सर्वास्तुम्बुरुणा सार्धमाह्वये सपरिच्छदाः॥
en: And those ladies that attend Sakra, and those that attend Brahmā. I invoke all these females well attired, in company with Tumuru.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अग्नीषोमौ कथं पूर्वमेकयोनी प्रवर्तितौ। एष मे संशयो जातस्तं छिन्धि मधुसूदन॥
en: How did Agni and Soma, in days of yore, attain to uniformity with regard to their original nature? Thus doubt has arisen in my mind. Do you remove it, O slayer of Madhu.

sa: पुरुषाणामयं तात दुर्वृत्तानां दुरात्मनाम्। कथितो वाक्यसंचारस्ततो विज्ञापयामि ते॥
en: You have described to us the slanderous speeches uttered by wicked men of bad conduct. I desire, however, to question you further.

sa: यदि मां प्रतियुद्ध्यन्ते देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। नैव सीता प्रदास्यामि सर्वलोकभयादपि॥
en: Even if the gods, Gandharvas, and Dānavas should array themselves against me, Sītā I shall not give, from fear of all creatures.

sa: वामादेशितमार्गेण मत्प्रसादान्महात्मना॥ पाञ्चालेन क्रमः प्राप्तस्तस्माद् भूतात् सनातनात्। बाभ्रव्यगोत्र: स बभौ प्रथम क्रमपारगः॥ नारायणाद् वरं लब्ध्वा प्राप्य योगमनुत्तमम्। क्रमं प्रणीय शिक्षां च प्रणयित्वा स गालवः॥ कण्डरीकोऽथ राजा च ब्रह्मदत्तः प्रतापवान्। जातीमरणजं दुःखं स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा पुनः पुनः॥ सप्तजातिषु मुख्यत्वाद् योगानां सम्पदं गतः।
en: Following the path pointed out by Vamadeva, the great Rishi Panchala, through my favour obtained from that eternal Being the rules of the division of syllables and words, Indeed, Galava, born in the Vabhravya race, having acquired high ascetic success and obtained a boon from Narayana, compiled the rules about the division of syllables and words and those about emphasis and accent in utterance, and appeared as the first scholar who became conversant with those two subjects. Repeatedly thinking of the sorrow of birth and death, Kundarika and king Brahmadatta attained to that property which is acquired by persons devoted to Yoga, in course of seven births, through my favour.

sa: युक्तिशास्त्रं च ते ज्ञेयं शब्दशास्त्रं च भारत॥ गान्धर्वशास्त्रं च कला: परिज्ञेया नराधिप।
en: You should, O king, be proficient in logic, as also the science of words, the science of music and the four and the sixty branches of knowledge known by the name of Kala.

sa: अवरा पतिता चैव न ग्राह्या भूतिमिच्छता॥ अग्नीनुत्पाद्य यत्नेन क्रियाः सुविहिताश्च याः। वेदे च ब्राह्मणैः प्रोक्तास्ताश्च सर्वाः समाचरेत्।।१३६ न चेा स्त्रीषु कर्तव्या रक्ष्या दाराश्च सर्वशः।
en: One who is desirous of his own prosperity, should never marry a woman who is of an inferior caste or who has fallen away from the caste of her birth. Carefully lighting up the fire, one should perform all those acts which have been ordained and declared in the Vedas or by the Brahinanas. One should never seek to injure women. Wives should always be protected.

sa: यौ तौ वृष्णिप्रवीराणां द्वावेवातिरथौ मतौ॥ प्रद्युस्रो युयुधानश्च कथयन् कत्थसे च यौ। तौ सदा कुरुशार्दूल कृष्णस्य प्रियभाजनौ॥ तावुभौ वृष्णिनाशस्य मुखमास्तां धनञ्जय।
en: Those two who considered as Atirathas amongst the foremost of the Vrishnis, and referring to whom in of conversation you were wont to indulge in pride, and who, O chief of Kuru's race, were ever dear to Krishna himself, alas, those tow, O Dhananjaya, have been the chief causes of the Destruction of the Vrishnis.

sa: युद्धे विक्रमतश्चैव हितं मन्त्रयतस्तया। सुग्रीवस्य ससैन्यस्य सफलोऽद्य परिश्रमः॥
en: The labour of Sugrīva with his army, who displayed valour in the encounter and gave me good counsels, has borne fruit today.

sa: गुरूंश्चाप्यवमन्यन्ते न तु रामजनार्दनौ। पल्य: पतीनुच्चरन्त पत्नीश्च पतयस्तथा॥
en: They insulted and humiliated their preceptors and elders. Only Rama and Janardana acted differently. Wives deceived their husbands, and husbands deceived wives.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच यैर्जिता भूमिपालाश्च दैत्याश्च शतशोऽर्जुन॥ तान् दृष्ट्वा नेह पश्यामि जीवाम्यर्जुन दुर्मरः।
en: Vasudeva said Without seeing those heroes, O Arjuna who had subjugated all the kings of the Earth and the Daityas a hundred time, I am still alive! I see, that I cannot die!

sa: तौ समेत्य महाराज कुरुचेदिवृषौ तदा। उभयोरात्मकुलयोः कौशल्यं पर्यपृच्छताम्॥
en: O great king, those two best of the Kuru and the Chedi race then met together and inquired after each other's welfare.

sa: परिगृह्य च तां दीनां कृष्णामजितनसंस्तरे। पार्था विश्रामयामासुर्लब्धसंज्ञां तपस्विनीम्॥
en: Placing the poor exhausted lady who had then regained her consciousness on a deer-skin, the sons of Pritha made her take rest.

sa: नल उवाच एवमेतद् यथाऽऽत्य त्वं दमयन्ति सुमध्यमे। नास्ति भार्यासमं मित्रं नरस्यार्तस्य भेषजम्॥
en: Nala said: O you of delicate loins! O Damayanti, what you have said, is indeed true; to a man aggrieved there is no friend equal to a wife that serves as a remedy.

sa: च्यवन उवाच शृणु सर्वमशेषेण यदिदं येन हेतुना। न हि शक्यमनाख्यातुमेवं पृष्टेन पार्थिव॥
en: Chyavana said Listen to me as I tell you fully the reasons which had moved me in all these acts of mine. Asked by you, O king, I cannot refuse to enlighten you.

sa: दमयन्त्युवाच यदि मां त्वं महाराज न विहातुमिहेच्छसि। तत् किमर्थं विदर्भाणां पन्थाः समुपदिश्यते॥
en: Damayanti said : O great monarch! if you seek not to desert me, why then do you instruct, (point out to) me, about the road that leads to the dominion of the Vidharbhas?

sa: ततस्तद्राक्षसं सैन्यं प्रयुद्धं समरुद्गणैः। रणे विद्रावितं सर्वं नानाप्रहरणैस्तदा॥
en: Thereupon the Rākşasas army began to fight with Maruts and they were overwhelmed in the encounter with the stroke of various weapons.

sa: रुद्र रौद्रा भविष्यन्ति पशवः सर्वकर्मसु॥ निपातयिष्यसे चैतानसुरान् भुवनेश्वर।
en: O Rudra, then creatures immolated in every sacrifice will be yours. Do you therefore, O lord of the universe, over-throw those Asuras.

sa: शीघ्रमानय सौमित्रि लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। भरतं च महाभागं शत्रुघ्नमपराजितम्॥
en: Do you bring in no time, Lakşmaņa, a son of Sumitrā, gifted with auspicious marks, alongwith great Bharata and the irrepressible Šatrughna.

sa: उदक्यया च सम्भाषां न कुर्वीत कदाचन॥ नोत्सृजेत पुरीषं च क्षेत्रे ग्रामस्य चान्तिके।
en: One should never even talk with a woman during the period of her menses. One should not answer a call of nature on a field or at place too near an inhabited village.

sa: एवमेतन्महाराज युद्धशेषमवर्तत। तव दुर्मत्रिते राजन् सह पुत्रस्य भारत॥
en: Thus, O king, the battle raged on all sides on account of the evil policy of yourself and your soni, O Bharata.

sa: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ। प्रदध्मतुः शङ्खवरौ हेमरत्नपरिष्कृतौ॥
en: Krishna and Arjuna riding on the same car yoked with (four) white horses, blew their excellent conchs adorned with gold and jewel.

sa: अमर्षवशमापन्नो योधयामास सृञ्जयान्। तस्य कीर्तिमतस्तात पुरा रामेण धीमता॥
en: Influenced by wrath fought with the Srinjayas. To your highly renowned father. O sire, in the days of yore, the intelligent Rama,

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं शरवृष्ट्या समाहताः। वध्यमानस्ततो राजन् पिता शान्तनवस्तव॥
en: Through afflicted with showers of arrows rushed at the son of Ganga. Thus assailed, O king, your father, the son of Shantanu,

sa: अचिन्त्यकल्पं नृपतेस्तं शोकमुपधारयन्। बभूव संरब्धतरः समुद्र इव पर्वणि।७।।
en: Thinking of this unthought of sorrow of the king he became agitated like to the ocean during the course of the full-moon.

sa: तस्मिन्नहं च क्रुद्ध वै जगत् त्यक्त्वा ततो गतः। व्यतिष्ठमग्निहोत्रे च चिरमङ्गिरसो भयात्॥
en: On another occasion, when Angirasa became enraged with me, I fled away, leaving the world, and lived for a long time concealed in the Agnihotra of the Brahmanas, through fear of that Rishi.

sa: घण्णामात्मनि नित्यानामैश्वर्यं योऽधिगच्छति। न स पापैः कुतोऽनर्थैर्युज्यते विजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: The self-controlled man who acquires over his six senses is never tainted with win; and consequently evil has no power over him.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच स्वभावात् सप्तहोतार इति मे पूर्विका मतिः। यथा वै पञ्चहोतारः परो भावस्तदुच्यताम्॥
en: The Brahmana's wife said I naturally believed that there are seven sacrificing priests. Let the great principle be declared to me as to how, indeed, the number is five of the sacrificing priests.

sa: भर्तारं तु परित्यज्य का स्त्री दैवतमात्मनः। इच्छेज्जीवितुमन्यत्र कैकेय्यास्त्यक्तधर्मणः॥
en: What other woman except Kaikeyi lost to righteousness, having lost her deity, her lord, wishes to carry on existence in another's kingdom?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु राजन यथाऽऽचष्ट फाल्गुनस्य हरिः प्रभुः। प्रसन्नात्माऽऽत्मनो नाम्नां निरुक्तं गुणकर्मजम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Listen, O king, to what the meanings are of the various names, due to attributes and acts, of Hari as the powerful Hari himself of cheerful soul explained them to Phalguna.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा खड्ड्रेन केशवस्य समीपतः। अभिद्रुत्य शिरः क्रुद्धश्चिच्छेद कृतवर्मणः॥
en: Having said these words, Satyaki rushed at Kritavarman and cut off his head with a sword in the very sight of Keshava.

sa: सर्वं बलवतां पथ्यं सर्वं बलवतां शुचि। सर्वं बलवतां धर्मः सर्वं बलवतां स्वकम्॥
en: Everything is becoming for those who are mighty. Everything is pure for those that are mighty. Everything is meritorious for those that are mighty. Everything is their own for those who are mighty.

sa: जङ्गमस्थावराणां च भूतानामसुराधिप। पार्थिवानामपि व्यक्तं मृत्यु पश्यामि सर्वशः॥
en: I see also the death, which is manifest, O chief of Asuras, of all things, mobile and immobile, belonging to the earth.

sa: अवश्यं कथनीयं मे तवैतन्नरपुङ्गव। यदर्थं त्वाहमुच्छेत्तुं सम्प्राप्तो मनुजाधिप॥
en: I should certainly, O king, tell you everything about the circumstance for which, O monarch, I came hither for exterminating your race.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसंघान्। ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थमृषीश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्॥
en: Arjuna said I behold, O Great God, all the celestial and all the varied hosts of creatures. I behold Brahma seated on his lotus-seat; I behold all the great Rishis and divine Nagas.

sa: कालस्य चाप्यहं कालो दहेयमपि पावकम्। मृत्यु मरणधर्मेण संयोजयितुमुत्सहे॥
en: I am the destroyer of the Destroyer himself; and I burn even very Fire. And I can bring Death itself to mortality.

sa: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च। गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघा वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे॥
en: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Visvas, the Ashvins, the Maruts, the Ushmapas, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Asuras, and hosts of Siddhyas see you; and they are all amazed.

sa: सा तस्य शुशुभे शाला ताभिःस्त्रीभिर्विराजिता। शरदीव प्रसन्ना द्यौस्ताराभिरभिशोभिता॥
en: And that apartment, in consequence of being graced by those women, appeared splendid, like the autumnal, complacent sky decorated with the stars.

sa: इत्येतत् ते महाराज पृच्छतः शास्त्रचक्षुषा॥ सर्वमुक्तं यथातत्त्वं तस्माच्छममवाप्नुहि।
en: O great king, with the help of the eye of science, I have told you all that you asked me. Be blessed.

sa: व्यास उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शङ्खच लिखितश्चास्तां भ्रातरौ संशितव्रतौ॥
en: Vyasa said 'In this matter is also cited this old history. There were two brothers, viz., Shankha and Likhita of rigid vows.

sa: आख्याता केन वा सीता मित्ररूपेण शत्रुणा। त्वया राक्षसशार्दूल को न नन्दति नन्दितः॥
en: What enemy of yours in the guise of a friend, has spoken of Sītā to you? And, O foremost of monarchs, who, having been, entertained by you, dose not bear you good will?

sa: तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन प्रत्यक्षो ह्यसि सर्वदा। मोक्षकामा वयं चापि काङ्क्षामो यदनामयम्। अदेहमजरं नित्यमतीन्द्रियमनीश्वरम्॥
en: We are desirous of acquiring Liberation. Indeed, we wish to acquire That which is auspicious, bodiless, not subject to decrepitude, eternal, beyond the perception of the senses, and having nothing superior to it.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौसल्या चिरकालाभिकासितम्। हर्षबाष्पाकुलं वाक्यमिदं राममभाषत ॥
en: Hearing of that for which she had ever wished, Kausalya, her voice choking with the vapour begot of delight, addressed Rāma, saying.

sa: अपृच्छत तदा रामो दक्षिणाशाश्रयं मुनिम्। प्राञ्जलिविनयोपेत इदमाह वचोऽर्थवत्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma, being stricken with curiosity, with folded palms and humbly accosted Agastya, residing in the southern quarter, with pregnant accents, saying.

sa: यः खड्गयोधी लघुचित्रहस्तो महांश्च धीमान् सहदेवोऽद्वितीयः॥ यस्याद्य कर्म द्रक्ष्यसे मूढसत्त्व शतक्रतोर्वा दैत्यसेनासु संख्ये। शूरः कृतास्त्रो मतिमान् मनस्वी प्रियङ्करो धर्मसुतस्य राज्ञः॥
en: That intelligent and great one, having Sahadeva for the second, is light-handed and an expert in the use of swords. O stupid man, you shall see to day his exploits in battle like those of Indra in the army of Daityas. Heroic, well-skilled in weapon, intelligent, wise, ever satisfying the king, the son of Dharma,

sa: महर्षिर्विश्रुतस्तात उत्तङ्क इति भारत। मरुधन्वसु रम्येषु आश्रमस्तस्य कौरव॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, O child, there was a celebrated great Rishi named Uttanka. He had his hermitage in a charming forest.

sa: अभिवाद्य ततो यक्षं द्वारपालं मचक्रुकम्। कोटितीर्थमुपस्पृश्य लभेद् बहुसुवर्णकम्॥
en: Bathing then in Koti Tirtha after having worshipped the Yaksha door-keeper, Machakruka, one obtains the fruits of giving away gold in abundance.

sa: सुयज्ञोऽप्यथ जाबालिः काश्यपोऽप्यथ गौतमः। मार्कण्डेयस्तु दीर्घायुस्तथा का.यायनो द्विजः॥
en: And he had other counsellors besides, viz; Suyajna, and Javali, and Kasyapa, and Gautama, and the long-lived Markandeya, and the regenerate Katyayana.

sa: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O foremost of men, bathing in the Tirtha called Kapalamochana which cleanses off one's sins, one is freed from all his sins.

sa: पाञ्चालराज्ञो विमलं पुण्डरीकाक्ष पाण्डुरम्। आतपत्रं समाभाति शरदीव निशाकरः॥
en: The bright and white umbrella, of the king of the Panchalas, shines, O lotus-eyed one, like the moon in the autumnal sky.

sa: सादिनः शिक्षिता राजन् परिवार्य महारथान्। विचरन्तो रणेऽभ्यघ्नन् प्रासशक्तवृष्टिभिस्तथा।।६।
en: Well-trained horsemen, king, surrounding great car-warriors, moved about in the field, striking and slaying the latter with spears and draft and swords.

sa: मृगीवोत्फुल्लनयना मृदुशीला मनस्विनी। अपकारं कमिव ते करोति जनकात्मजा॥
en: Of eyes expanded like those of a doe, endued with a mild temperament, and virtuous, what harm has Janaka's daughter done you.

sa: अवश्यं नरकास्तात द्रष्टव्याः सर्वराजभिः। ततस्त्वया प्राप्तमिदं मुहूर्तं दुःखमुत्तमम्॥
en: Forsooth, all kings, O son, must once see Hell. Hence have you for a little while been subjected to this great sorrow.

sa: तेषां तु द्वारपालानामेकः शोकसमन्वितः॥ मध्यं गतमिवादित्यं दृष्ट्वा शुकमवस्थितम्।
en: Among those porters there was one who felt mercy for him, seeing him staying there like the midday Sun in his effulgence.
